fdroid:br.com.jotdown.name: Jotdown
fdroid:br.com.jotdown.summary: Offline PDF reader with OCR and academic annotations.
fdroid:br.com.jotdown.description:
Jotdown is an open-source document manager and PDF reader built for researchers, students and academics. Reading, annotating and organizing your documents works fully offline; network is only used for optional DOI citation import and dictionary downloads. Focused on privacy — no account required, no data leaves the device beyond what those optional features need.
Features:
* PDF reader with text-layer extraction
* OCR via open-source PdfBox
* Sticky note annotations and vector drawings (stylus + palm rejection)
* Academic citation (fichamento) generator
* Export to Markdown (.md), TXT and PDF
* ABNT citation format support
* Local folder organisation system
* Offline dictionary (Portuguese / English)
* Backup and restore (local ZIP)
* Dark mode support

fdroid:com.steamserverbrowser.app.name: Steam Server Browser
fdroid:com.steamserverbrowser.app.summary: Browse A2S-compatible Steam game servers on Android
fdroid:com.steamserverbrowser.app.description:
SteamServerBrowser for Android is a Flutter port focused on Steam server discovery
and A2S-compatible server queries.
Features:
* Browse Steam master server results through the Steam Web API.
* Query live A2S_INFO, A2S_PLAYER, and A2S_RULES data.
* Refresh loaded servers without fetching a new master list.
* Save favorites and manually add IP:port entries.
* Filter by map, tags, ping, players, countries, and local search text.
* Import an optional MMDB database for offline country lookup.
The app does not bundle an MMDB database. Geo features stay disabled until the
user imports one manually.

fdroid:cube.run.name: Cube Run
fdroid:cube.run.summary: Dodge, jump and slam through a neon 3-lane gauntlet. One-thumb 3D runner.
fdroid:cube.run.description:
Cube Run is a minimalist one-thumb 3D runner. The world rushes toward you down a neon three-lane track, and your cube has to dodge, jump, slide and slam its way through everything in the way.
Swipe left or right to snap between lanes, swipe up to leap low walls, swipe down to slide under overhead bars — or swipe down in mid-air to slam back to the ground in a hurry. Pillars and wide bars leave just one survivable lane, and once you get going some obstacles slide sideways into the open lane as they approach — so read the track and commit at the last moment.
Score a point for every row you clear, with a bonus for shaving past an obstacle by a hair. The track speeds up the longer you survive, the colours drift across the spectrum, and a single mistimed move ends the run in a burst of shards.
Features:
* One-thumb controls: swipe to switch lanes, jump, slide and slam.
* An endless, procedurally generated track — no two runs are alike.
* A relentless difficulty ramp that rewards nerve and near-misses.
* Tight, tactile feedback with synchronised sound and haptics.
* A local high score. No accounts, no ads, no tracking, no network access.
* Tiny download and fully playable offline.
Cube Run is built with libGDX and is free and open-source software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

fdroid:dev.arnv.bluke.name: Bluke
fdroid:dev.arnv.bluke.summary: Use your phone as a Bluetooth keyboard, gamepad, trackpad, and media remote
fdroid:dev.arnv.bluke.description:
Bluke lets you use your Android phone as a wireless keyboard, mouse trackpad, game controller, and media remote.
It utilizes your phone's built-in Bluetooth HID profile and acts like how a typical input device would work.
No installing server apps or background clients, just pair, connect and it works.
Features:
* Keyboard mode with real mechanical typing sounds (12 built-in switches, custom Mechvibes pack import, Fn media shortcuts, and international layouts).
* Trackpad mode with smooth cursor control, natural two-finger scrolling, tap-and-drag, and an LED numpad overlay.
* Gamepad mode with dual analog sticks, Xbox/PS5 button styles, stick inversion, and Native/Web/Android controller profiles.
* Multimedia remote mode for media playback and slideshow presentations, with optional phone volume rocker control.
* Stays connected in the background and with the screen locked while in use.
* Material You dynamic themes, custom color palettes, adjustable haptic feedback, and auto-reconnect on launch.
Bluke is 100% offline, everything stays local, no tracking, and it is fully open source. Source code can be accessed at: https://github.com/arnav-kr/Bluke

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.complica4.name: Complica4
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.complica4.description:
Complica4 is a modified version for four players of the game Complica, 
which is similar to the game Connect Four. In Complica (not like in Connect
Four), when a piece is placed, it does not remain there for the entire game.
Another piece may be used to slide the entire row over. Winner is first person
to have 4 pieces in a row. The mechanic of the sliding rows means that each
player can possibly have 4 in a row at the same time, causing the game to
continue until this situation can be broken up.

fdroid:io.github.anrinion.baseline.name: Baseline
fdroid:io.github.anrinion.baseline.summary: Gentle self-care for depression, disability, chronic illness, or burnout
fdroid:io.github.anrinion.baseline.description:
The Baseline is a minimal, gentle self-care app companion designed for people who struggle to maintain basic level of functioning. It aims to help with these foundations, without pressure, motivation attempts or guilt promotion.
The app consists of modules that can be enabled or disabled as needed:
- Food — make sure you eat at least something every day
- Movement — moving around is really beneficial
- Sleep — if you don't wear any tracking device, you may want to check that you sleep enough
- Mental state — tools inspired by Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles
- Medications — Medication reminders with optional notifications (DO NOT USE for critical medications where delay is life-threatening)
- Grounding — a big green button that you can press
Privacy and policies:
- No tracking — No analytics, cloud sync, or data collection. The app does not use network connection, ever
- No health data access — The app does not connect to Google Fit/Apple Health or any other health data source
- No history — The app does not store your history. The state resets each day
- No advertising
- No paywalls reducing functionality
fdroid:io.github.anrinion.baseline.category: Diet, Health Manager, Medication, Mental Health

fdroid:io.github.rotundtapir.fivehundred.name: 500 - Multiplayer card game
fdroid:io.github.rotundtapir.fivehundred.summary: Play 500, the Australian trick-taking card game — bots or friends online.
fdroid:io.github.rotundtapir.fivehundred.description:
500 is the classic trick-taking card game of Australia and New Zealand. Outbid the other side, call trumps, and steer your partnership to 500 points — with the Joker, both bowers, and the ever-tempting Misère along the way.
New to 500? The interactive tutorial deals you a real hand and coaches you through every bid, discard and trick — the fastest way to learn the game that keeps families arguing (fondly) for generations.
Features:
* Full Australian rules: a 43-card deck with the Joker, both bowers, a 3-card kitty, bidding from 6 to 10 tricks across the suits and no-trumps, plus Misère and Open Misère.
* Play offline against capable AI opponents — no account, no network required.
* Play online with friends: create or join a room with a short code, with cross-play between Android and the web. Any empty seats fill with bots, and if someone drops out a bot plays their hand until they rejoin. No account needed, and you can point the app at your own server.
* Four ways to play: the classic 4-player partnership game, 2-player head-to-head, or 6 players as two teams of three or three teams of two.
* Interactive tutorial that teaches by playing, not by reading.
* House rules: switch Misère or no-trumps bidding off to match how your table plays.
* Learn to count cards: hold each finished trick on the table for as long as you like, and slow down or speed up the pace to taste.
* A proper score sheet: every hand's contract and points, tallied at game end.
* First side to 500 points wins.
This app is free and open source. Source code at https://github.com/rotundtapir/500

fdroid:space.celestia.mobilecelestia.name: Celestia
fdroid:space.celestia.mobilecelestia.description:
Celestia — real-time 3D visualization of space
Note: this is an unofficial version of Celestia. It may be slow to update or miss some features.
3D Space Simulator | Celestia lets you explore our universe in three dimensions.
Celestia simulates many different types of celestial objects. From planets and moons to star clusters and galaxies, you can visit every object in the expandable database and view it from any point in space and time. The position and movement of solar system objects is calculated accurately in real time at any rate desired.
Interactive Planetarium | Celestia serves as a planetarium – for an observer on any celestial object.
You can easily navigate to any world and land on its surface. When used as a planetarium, Celestia shows accurate positions of solar system objects in the sky. You can switch labels and other supporting features on and off with hotkeys, or zoom in and out on an object of interest, for example Jupiter’s system of moons.
Expandable Content | Customize Celestia according to your needs.
Celestia’s catalogues can be easily expanded. There are many different add-ons available containing new objects like comets or stars, high-resolution textures of Earth and other well mapped solar system bodies, as well as 3D models for asteroids and spacecraft on precise trajectories. Even fictional objects from well-known sci-fi franchises can be found.

flathub:com.dec05eba.gpu_screen_recorder.name: GPU Screen Recorder
flathub:com.dec05eba.gpu_screen_recorder.summary: A shadowplay-like screen recorder for Linux. The fastest screen recorder for Linux
flathub:com.dec05eba.gpu_screen_recorder.description:
This is a screen recorder that has minimal impact on system performance by recording a monitor
 using the GPU only, similar to shadowplay on windows. This is the fastest screen recording tool
 for Linux. This screen recorder works on X11 and Wayland on AMD, Intel and NVIDIA.
 This screen recorder can be used for recording your desktop offline, for live streaming and
 for nvidia shadowplay-like instant replay, where only the last few minutes are saved.
 This flatpak is designed to support hardware video encoding with both old and new GPUs.
 Supported video codecs:
 H264 (default)
 HEVC (Optionally with HDR)
 AV1 (Optionally with HDR)
 VP8
 VP9
 Supported audio codecs:
 Opus (default)
 AAC
 Supported image formats:
 JPEG
 PNG
 At the moment the program comes with two different UIs. A gtk based one and a new experimental
 ShadowPlay-like fullscreen overlay UI. The gtk based UI will be removed in the future. You can
 switch to the new UI by clicking on "Try out the new UI" and then after that is done press Left
 Alt+Z to open/close it.
 Videos are in variable framerate format by default. Use MPV to play such videos, otherwise you
 might experience stuttering in the video if you are using a buggy video player. Alternatively change
 framerate mode to constant framerate.
 For more information visit the GPU Screen Recorder homepage.
 If you use the new UI and also keyboard remapping software such as keyd then make sure you make
 the keyboard remapping software ignores "gsr-ui virtual keyboard" (dec0:5eba device id), otherwise
 you may be unable to use your keyboard. You can press (left) ctrl+shift+alt+esc to close gpu screen
 recorder and remove it from system startup if this happens. You should also change hotkeys option
 in gpu screen recorder to only grab virtual devices when using keyboard remapping software.
 GPU Screen Recorder flatpak can install files in $HOME/.local/share/gpu-screen-recorder. If
 you want to uninstall GPU Screen Recorder then you will have to remove this directory manually.
 If you tried out the new UI then an xdg autostart desktop entry was added to ~/.config/autostart/gpu-screen-recorder-ui.desktop.
 If you want to uninstall GPU Screen Recorder then you will have to remove that file and ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gpu-screen-recorder@dec05eba.com/
 as well (if you use GNOME).

flathub:com.github.emmanueltouzery.proje.name: Projectpad
flathub:com.github.emmanueltouzery.proje.summary: Projectpad allows to manage secret credentials and server information that you need to handle as a software developer or sysadmin.
flathub:com.github.emmanueltouzery.proje.description:
Projectpad allows to manage secret credentials and server information that you need to handle as a software developer or sysadmin. List of servers, list of point of interests on those servers (applications, log files, databases, servers). It will securely store passwords and keys. It will also allow you to run commands (locally or on SSH servers), open terminals on remote SSH servers, and so on. The data is securely stored on-disk using SQLcipher, which uses 256-bit AES. The database is password-protected, but you can store the password in your OS keyring. Since the database is encrypted, you can put it in your dropbox (or similar account), to share it between computers.
 Projectpad's target audience are people who today have to use several tools to do their work effectively: a keepass-like application, a series of text files with notes, and a few shell scripts. Instead of that, projectpad offers a streamlined, integrated solution.
 Projectpad consists of two applications:
 the GUI projectpad application, which allows you to enter/edit data, search it, open websites and so on (included in this flatpak);
 the command-line ppcli application, which allows you to run commands, connect to servers, open files of interest and so on (must be installed separately, see https://github.com/emmanueltouzery/projectpad2).

flathub:com.makemkv.MakeMKV.name: MakeMKV
flathub:com.makemkv.MakeMKV.summary: DVD and Blu-ray to MKV converter and network streamer
flathub:com.makemkv.MakeMKV.description:
MakeMKV is your one-click solution to convert video that you own
 into free and patents-unencumbered format that can be played
 everywhere. MakeMKV is a format converter, otherwise called
 "transcoder". It converts the video clips from proprietary (and
 usually encrypted) disc into a set of MKV files, preserving most
 information but not changing it in any way. The MKV format can
 store multiple video/audio tracks with all meta-information and
 preserve chapters.
 Additionally MakeMKV can instantly stream decrypted video
 without intermediate conversion to wide range of players, so you
 may watch Blu-ray and DVD discs with your favorite player on
 your favorite OS or on your favorite device.
 NOTE: users of this software must accept the terms of the "End
 User License Agreement".

fedora-packages:admesh/admesh.description: ADMesh is a program for diagnosing and/or repairing commonly encountered problems with STL (STereo Lithography) data files. It can remove degenerate and unconnected facets, connect nearby facets, fill holes by adding facets, and repair facet normals. Simple transformations such as scaling, translation and rotation are also supported. ADMesh can read both ASCII and binary format STL files, while the output can be in AutoCAD DXF, Geomview OFF, STL, or VRML format.

fedora-packages:bup/bup.summary: Very efficient backup system based on the git packfile format
fedora-packages:bup/bup.description: bup is a program that backs things up. It uses a rolling checksum algorithm (similar to rsync) to split large files into chunks, and stores them in the git packfile format, so it is very efficient with large files, VM images, and databases, and only stores identical chunks once. It supports incremental backups to local or remote repositories, par2-based recovery, a FUSE view of the repository, and an optional web interface.

The exact format and output method can be customized by the administrator via a configuration file. This package is the runtime part of the library.

It allows you to write tests as general properties that should hold true for your code, and the QuickCheck package will then generate a large number of random test cases to try and find a counterexample. Features: - Property-Based Testing: Define properties and let the framework generate test data automatically. - Automatic Sizing: The package automatically tries a range of different sizes for the generated objects, starting with small and simple cases to find the minimal counterexamples first. - Variety of Types: It supports random generation for a range of common GAP types.

Clipboard History IO - Open Source Clipboard Manager & History for Chrome
The most secure clipboard history manager for Chrome - fully open source, privacy-focused, and packed with powerful features. Experience professional clipboard management without compromising your security.
Why Clipboard History IO?
Unlike traditional clipboard managers that require invasive permissions to "read and change all your data on all websites," Clipboard History IO only accesses your clipboard - nothing more. As the first fully open-source clipboard history extension, every line of code is transparent and auditable on GitHub, ensuring your sensitive data stays secure.
🚀 Powerful Features for Every User
• Complete Clipboard History - Never lose copied text again. Access your entire clipboard history with instant search, favorites, and custom tags for organization.
• Multiple Access Methods - Use clipboard history your way: popup window, floating resizable window, Chrome sidebar panel, right-click context menu, or keyboard shortcuts. Quick access with Alt+Shift+V to open the extension instantly, plus Alt+Shift+1/2/3 for direct pasting.
• Smart Organization - Tag entries with colors, mark favorites, search instantly, and sort by date or alphabetically. Monitor your storage usage with the built-in storage analytics tool to optimize your clipboard history. Perfect for managing code snippets, passwords, templates, and frequently-used text.
• Cross-Device Sync (Pro) - Seamlessly sync your clipboard across all devices. Copy on your computer, paste on your phone with our native mobile apps - now available on the App Store for iOS ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clipboard-history-io-mobile/id6747272140 ) and Google Play Store for Android ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andyluyoung.clipboardhistoryio ). True universal clipboard access.
• Import/Export & Migration - Switch from Clipboard History Pro or other clipboard managers easily. Export your data anytime for backup or portability.
• Advanced Merge Tool - Combine multiple clipboard entries into one. Essential for developers merging code blocks or writers combining research notes.
• Customizable Experience - Dark/light themes, adjustable storage limits, default tab preferences, and multiple language support.
🔐 Security First Approach
Your clipboard contains sensitive information - passwords, personal data, confidential documents. That's why Clipboard History IO is built with security as the foundation:
 Minimal permissions (clipboard access only)
 Local storage by default (no cloud required)
 Open source transparency
 No tracking or analytics
 Regular security updates
💼 Perfect For:
Developers - Manage API keys, code snippets, terminal commands, and configuration files with tags and search.
Writers - Organize research, quotes, and drafts. Never lose important edits or references.
Professionals - Quick access to email templates, meeting links, and frequently-used information.
Security-Conscious Users - The only clipboard manager with verifiable privacy through open-source code.
🌟 What Makes Us Different
While other clipboard extensions remain closed-source black boxes, Clipboard History IO provides complete transparency. Compatible with both Chrome and Firefox, supporting Manifest V3 for future-proof performance. Import your existing data from Clipboard History Pro and experience a better, more secure clipboard manager.
Pro Features: Unlock cloud synchronization to access your clipboard history from any device. Download our mobile apps from the App Store for iOS ( https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clipboard-history-io-mobile/id6747272140 ) and Google Play Store for Android ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andyluyoung.clipboardhistoryio ) for seamless cross-platform access. Your clipboard becomes truly universal - copy anywhere, paste everywhere.
Join thousands of users who've chosen security without sacrificing functionality. Your clipboard history should be private, secure, and always accessible - with Clipboard History IO, it finally is.

Support & Updates: https://github.com/ayoung19/clipboard-history/releases

bluejetty:00041189:ios.name: Radiacode
bluejetty:00041189:ios.summary: Discover the full potential of Radiacode, a device designed for smart, flexible, and efficient operations, which transforms into an even more powerful tool when paired with the Radiacode application, thereby enhancing device capabilities in
bluejetty:00041189:ios.description:
Discover the full potential of Radiacode, a device designed for smart, flexible, and efficient operations, which transforms into an even more powerful tool when paired with the Radiacode application, thereby enhancing device capabilities in radiation monitoring and data analysis.
INTERACTIVE DASHBOARD
Experience a user-friendly, real-time dashboard that displays comprehensive gamma energy and source analysis metrics, offering seamless navigation across all tools.
SEARCHER
The feature introduces an advanced ionizing radiation search function, equipped with an optimal averaging algorithm that enhances data processing and significantly improves responsiveness, providing users with precise and efficient real-time monitoring of radiation levels across diverse environments.
SIGNALISATION
The feature enhances the application with critical safety tools, activating alarms when detected radiation surpasses preset limits and providing users the flexibility to deactivate these alerts, ensuring a comprehensive approach to radiation monitoring and response.
GAMMA SPECTROMETRY AND ISOTOPE VISUALIZATION
Radiacode uniquely visualizes isotopes by interpreting the radiation spectrum, revealing varied gamma energy levels and enabling precise discrimination between different radiation elements for an engaging analytical experience.
Visualize isotopes such as Radium-226 and Cesium-137 with ease, revealing varied gamma energy levels for a thorough understanding of different radiation elements, using technology previously exclusive to expensive laboratory equipment, now available in a portable, cost-effective format.
SPECTROGRAM
The spectrogram feature enhances data visualization and analysis in radiation spectrometry. It allows users to view the distribution of gamma radiation intensity across various energy levels in a visual format, making it easier to analyze and interpret radiation data. This function provides a detailed visual representation of the radiation spectrum, improving the ability to monitor and understand variations in radiation levels over time. 
DOSE MONITOR
Monitor your radiation exposure throughout the day with a clear and intuitive overview of your accumulated dose. Track how your exposure evolves over time, identify spikes, and compare your data against reference safety levels for better awareness and control. The system automatically subtracts background radiation for improved accuracy and synchronizes environmental data via Radiaverse based on your location. bluejetty:00064253:ios.description:
Topstars: Soccer Origins – Build, Battle & Conquer the Field!
Step into the brutal world of the Shrovetide Soccer during the XVIII century, a sport where raw strength, strategy, and determination decide the victory. Inspired by folk football, carnival football, and medieval football, this intense PvP game throws you into a chaotic battlefield where scoring goals is just as important as overpowering your opponents.
BUILD YOUR TEAM AND CRUSH YOUR OPPONENTS
• Recruit and train a squad of real warriors, each with unique skills and attributes.
• Choose from legendary factions such as The Butchers, The Fish Harvesters, The Steelers, The Shipyards, and more.
• Upgrade your players to increase their strength, endurance, and tactical abilities.
• Formulate the perfect balance between offense and defense to control the game.
NO REFEREES, NO RULES, JUST WAR
• Engage in fierce, full-contact battles where brute force is a valid strategy.
• Knock out opponents to gain the upper hand and create scoring opportunities.
• Use your substitutes wisely — when players take too much damage, swap them out to keep the fight going.
• Adapt your playstyle based on your team's strengths and the weaknesses of your enemies.
REAL-TIME PvP SHOWDOWNS
• Challenge real players in intense online PvP matches where only the strongest survive.
• Experiment with different team compositions and strategies to outmaneuver rivals.
• Progress through competitive rankings and prove your dominance on the battlefield.
• Experience dynamic matchups that require skill, adaptability, and quick decision-making.
A SOCCER LOVERS EXPERIENCE LIKE NO OTHER
• Play in immersive industrial environments, from muddy village streets to grand tournament arenas.
• Experience a sport where honor, pride, and brute force dictate the outcome.
• Unlock new teams, special abilities, and advanced tactics as you progress.
• Witness the brutal clashes of a time when soccer was more than just a game — it was a battle for supremacy.
TACTICAL DEPTH AND TEAM MANAGEMENT
• Customize your squad’s formation and strategy before each match.
• Strengthen individual players through rigorous training and strategic upgrades.
• Rotate your lineup based on injuries and stamina to maintain peak performance.
• Adapt to your opponent’s tactics and shift your game plan mid-match to secure victory.
Once upon a time Soccer was not just about scoring goals — was about dominating the battlefield, outlasting your rivals, and proving your team is the toughest in history.
Do you have what it takes to conquer the field? Download now and enter the fight!
This application offers integrated purchases. You can deactivate them in your device settings. This application needs you to accept the "Privacy Policy" and the "Legal Notice".

- Endless fun and humor pranking your friends!
- Free and Fun!
Note: For best accelerometer/touch results change the Auto-Lock setting to 5 Minutes or Never (Settings/General/Auto-Lock)
Fart Cushion was originally submitted on August 29th, 2008.

Whether you're a seasoned basketball pro or a total beginner, you'll be able to jump right in and start blocking shots and dunking on your friends.
With powerful but easy controls, Basketball Battle puts you in complete control of your player on the basketball court. ● Break angles and get buckets!
● Score 3 buckets to catch on fire!
● Daily events with online leaderboards
● Unlock tournaments with huge rewards!
● Build and customize your team!
● Over 100 tournaments with unique courts!
Are you ready for some basketball?

bluejetty:00022368:ios.description:
Enjoy a Mahjong Puzzle Game in 3D; introducing Mahjong Dimensions.
Mahjong Dimensions 3D Cube Puzzle Game is easy to play. Spin the puzzle cube to match all the Mahjong tiles. Match 2 identical Mahjong tiles to make them disappear. When you’ve matched them all you will progress to the next level.
Mahjong games are a fan favorite among puzzle game players. Mahjong Dimensions was inspired by traditional Mahjong & this game gives an exciting 3D twist to classic mahjong. 
HOW TO PLAY:
- Find matching 3D tiles – spin the 3D Mahjong puzzle to match them all.
- Our Mahjong 3D puzzle game is simple to play: find & match tile pairs in the 3D cube.
- Win by matching tiles that are not blocked by other tiles on the left or right sides of the 3D Cube.
- Match Mahjong tiles as fast as you can to complete all levels of the game.
This unique 3D Mahjong game is easy and fun to play. Download Mahjong Dimensions & relax while you play for free and become a cube master.
Arkadium’s Mahjong Dimensions 3D Cube match game is based on Chinese tile matching games. Whether you know it as Mahjong, Mahjong, or Mahjong, mahjong games make for hours of fun, epic and relaxing game play!
========================================================================
3D MAHJONG DIMENSIONS HAS MANY UNIQUE PUZZLE GAME FEATURES 
X5 Multi Tile Match - The unique Multi Match Combo feature is one of the most exciting features in Arkadium’s Mahjong Dimensions game. Get bonus points by matching the same images in a row. This point multiplier will help you defeat the puzzle in record time.
Unique Gameplay Experience - See the entire mahjong 3D puzzle with ease. Easily find matching tiles, then simply tap them to match and they disappear. Relax and enjoy matching games to become a puzzle cube master!
Race Against the Clock Match - match as many 3D tiles as you can on the board with the amount of time given. Complete as many puzzles as you can before the time runs out.
Offline Mahjong Games Free - Mahjong Dimensions is available to play offline. Even if you don’t have access to wifi you can enjoy your favourite 3d Mahjong puzzle game. 
SPEED MATCH COMBO - One of Mahjong Dimensions players most exciting and loved features. Get a point multiplier by making a match within 3 seconds of another match and get a point multiplier to get to the next level of the puzzle game faster.
Get more out of Mahjong Dimensions with Arkadium Advantage:
- Untimed mode – play without a timer
- Ad free gameplay – play Arkadium’s Mahjong Dimensions 3D without ads
- A personal account to track your progress
- Automatic 15% discounts on in-game purchases
- And much more!

bluejetty:00039476:ios.description:
Discover the Easiest Way to Invest: The Shariah-Compliant Way
Abyan Capital makes investing simple, smart, and fully Shariah-compliant. Whether you're starting your financial journey or aiming to grow and diversify your wealth, Abyan brings all your saving and investing needs together in one secure, easy-to-use app.
Invest, Save, and Grow in One Place
Open your account in just 3 minutes and receive a recommended portfolio tailored to your goals and risk level. With Abyan Capital, you invest confidently knowing your money is managed ethically and aligned with Islamic principles. Your portfolio returns are automatically purified, ensuring full Shariah compliance at all times.
Smart, Diversified Portfolios for Every Investor
Choose from expertly built portfolios designed for all risk appetites, from conservative to adventurous. Your returns are reinvested automatically to support long-term growth, and you can customize your portfolio anytime with preferred assets and allocation percentages.
Save Smarter and Earn More
Grow your savings with an expected annual return of +5%, enjoy instant withdrawals, and earn daily returns. Organize your savings into multiple categories, travel, education, your child’s future, to track progress easily and stay on target.
Plan, Automate, and Stay Consistent
Recurring Payments: Build better habits with automated monthly deposits that keep your investments growing without manual transfers. Abyan supports both Mada and Visa for effortless payments.
Financial Plan: Create your own financial plan, track your goals, and monitor your progress. Abyan gives you the tools to stay aligned with your long-term vision and invest with clarity.
Experience Abyan Tiers: Rewarding Your Growth
Regular: Ideal for new investors, offering full flexibility and ease of access.
Premium: For portfolios above 200K SAR, enjoy 40% lower fees and dedicated advisor support.
Private: For portfolios above 500K SAR, benefit from 60% lower fees and a personal relationship manager.
Weekly Updates
We deliver weekly updates to continuously enhance your investing experience. These updates introduce new and improved product features, expanded product offerings for every investment use case, and clear, easy-to-digest performance insights with summarized market analysis across key assets and ETFs. This ensures you stay informed, empowered, and equipped with the right tools every week.
Easy, Secure, and Accessible for Everyone
Simple and Fast Deposits: Enjoy instant deposits through Apple Pay, credit card, or bank transfer, starting from just 50 SAR. Whether you're beginning your journey or adding to your portfolio, funding your account is seamless anytime.
Transparent Insights and Support: Stay informed with monthly performance reports that clearly show your returns. Our dedicated customer service team is always available to assist you.
Security You Can Trust: Abyan protects your data and funds with advanced security standards, strict regulatory oversight, and fully Shariah-compliant practices, giving you complete peace of mind.
Why Abyan Capital?
Monthly performance reports to keep you confident in your progress.
Active Jadwa fund for investors seeking exposure to the Saudi market.

bluejetty:00128216:ios.description:
What if five quiet minutes a day could change how you feel, think, and pray?

PAUSE & REFLECT
What are you most grateful for today? What made you laugh or smile today?
"The more thankful I am, the more content I get." 
"Gratitude helps me grow through tough times." 
"I choose to see this season of my life with appreciation."
Discover a peaceful space for daily Christian reflection, meditation, and spiritual growth. This app combines Bible verses, short devotionals, and guided gratitude journaling. Whether you're seeking Christian encouragement, consistency in your faith walk, or a gentle way to slow down and hear from God, our Bible journaling experience offers a simple rhythm rooted in truth and grace.
WHAT YOU’LL EXPERIENCE
* Daily Bible Verses - Handpicked Scriptures to inspire and spiritually ground you each day.
* Heartfelt Devotionals - Bite-sized Christian devotionals for reflection, clarity, and a deeper faith journey.
* Guided Gratitude Journaling - Gentle prompts to cultivate daily thankfulness and notice life's blessings.
* Reflection & Prayer Tools - A dedicated space for prayer, Scripture reflection, and building a stronger prayer life.
* Evening Meditations & Journaling - End-of-day prompts and meditations for peaceful sleep and calm.
WHY CHRISTIAN JOURNALING MATTERS
Christian journaling isn’t about being perfect; it’s about being present and connecting with God daily. It’s a powerful way to notice how God shows up in your everyday life and record moments where grace meets your story. This app helps you cultivate a deeper personal relationship with God and consistent spiritual growth.
THIS APP HELPS YOU:
* Stay spiritually grounded through consistent Scripture reading.
* Cultivate a daily rhythm of gratitude and prayer.
* Reflect on God’s faithfulness in every season of your life.
* Replace worry with peace, and noise with stillness and spiritual calm.
DESIGNED FOR SIMPLICITY & PURPOSE
Experience Christian meditation and daily devotionals without distraction. Our app offers a pressure-free space to slow down and connect with what truly matters: your relationship with God. It's the perfect companion for your quiet time.
PERFECT FOR:
- Christians building a daily faith habit.
- Anyone desiring peace, gratitude, and spiritual clarity in their daily life.
- Daily use during quiet time, devotions, prayer, or before bedtime reflection.
"Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly." – Colossians 3:16
Slow down, breathe, and reconnect. Download Gratitude - Christian Journal today.

bluejetty:00031423:ios.summary: Introducing MonAi, the app that revolutionizes how you track your daily expenses. With a fun, easy, and beautiful interface, MonAi simplifies expense tracking like never before. No more time-consuming data entry. Enter your expenses just li
bluejetty:00031423:ios.description:
Introducing MonAi, the app that revolutionizes how you track your daily expenses. With a fun, easy, and beautiful interface, MonAi simplifies expense tracking like never before. No more time-consuming data entry. Enter your expenses just like a voice message and MonAi will automatically split and categorize it for you. No login required, all saved securely in your personal iCloud.
EFFORTLESS EXPENSE TRACKING
Experience the future of expense tracking with MonAi's seamless voice input feature. Effortlessly capture your expenses by simply speaking them out loud. MonAi's robust AI algorithms intelligently categorize and divide your expenses without any manual effort on your part. Don't worry if voice input isn't your preference—MonAi offers versatile options. Enter expenses manually and still benefit from the app's intelligent categorization. Alternatively, drag and drop a category onto the input field to define your own custom category. MonAi adapts to your needs, making expense tracking quick, fun, and tailored to your style.
BEAUTIFUL UI/UX DESIGN
Enjoy a delightful and user-friendly interface, carefully designed to elevate your expense tracking experience. Embracing simplicity and elegance, MonAi's user-friendly design ensures that you can focus on what matters—your finances. Unlike overwhelming apps with unnecessary features, MonAi strips away the clutter, presenting you with a streamlined and intuitive interface that makes tracking expenses a pleasure.
PRIVACY-FRIENDLY AND SECURE
Rest assured knowing that your expense data is stored securely in your own personal iCloud. MonAi values your privacy and does not require any login credentials and doesn't have access to any of your data.
Download MonAi now and discover a seamless and efficient way to track your expenses. Take control of your finances and experience the convenience of MonAi.
Get to know the app and all of it’s features first with a free trial before you can choose between a monthly or yearly subscription. The subscription will automatically renew at the end of the period, for the same price. You can turn off the auto-renewal at any time up until 24-hours before the end of the subscription period in your Account Settings. When you cancel the auto-renewal, access to the "Pro features" will not expire immediately, you will have access until the end of the current payment period.
Read more about it in the terms of service: https://www.get-monai.app/terms

bluejetty:00154267:ios.description:
Study Guard – Turn Your Social Media Addiction into a Learning Powerhouse
Never wait for study motivation again with Study Guard—the app that holds you accountable to mastering your flashcards. Transform your social media habits into an unexpected ally for academic success.
SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED - Study Guard requires a paid subscription to access all features after your free trial ends.
WHAT YOU GET WITH YOUR SUBSCRIPTION:
- Social Media Leverage
Instead of letting endless scrolling derail your study sessions, Study Guard uses your social media habits as motivation. Each glance at your apps becomes a chance to earn time by proving your mastery of flashcards.
- Accountability at Its Best
Study Guard holds you directly accountable. Answer your flashcards correctly to unlock your phone and access social media, ensuring you stay committed to reviewing the material you worked hard to create.
- Custom Flashcard Creation
Use our intuitive interface to create custom flashcards manually. Spend hours preparing your content? With Study Guard, every flashcard counts.
- AI Flashcard Generator
Automatically generate flashcards from your notes and PDFs in 20+ languages. Save time and create comprehensive study materials effortlessly.
- Focus-Driven Learning
When it's time to study, distractions are minimized. The app temporarily blocks access to social media until you achieve your study goals, turning the habit that once hindered you into a powerful tool for concentration.
- Progress Tracking & Insights
Monitor your performance with detailed analytics. Track your success, identify areas for improvement, and stay motivated to keep pushing your boundaries.
- Unlimited Flashcard Sets
Create and manage as many flashcard decks as you need for all your subjects and learning goals.
SUBSCRIPTION & FREE TRIAL:
Study Guard requires a subscription to use. Start with a FREE TRIAL to experience all features at no cost. After your trial ends, a paid subscription is required to continue using the app. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Download Study Guard now and let your passion for social media fuel your path to knowledge. Whether you're a student striving for excellence or a lifelong learner seeking to optimize your study routines, Study Guard integrates seamlessly into your lifestyle, making every moment count.
TERMS: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00187070:ios.name: WaiverForever - Online Waiver
bluejetty:00187070:ios.summary: WaiverForever provides a simple, safe and unified tool that allows businesses to create customized electronic waiver documents to be signed, collected and stored safely. No more piles of paper or misplaced forms; with WaiverForever's fantas
bluejetty:00187070:ios.description:
WaiverForever provides a simple, safe and unified tool that allows businesses to create customized electronic waiver documents to be signed, collected and stored safely. No more piles of paper or misplaced forms; with WaiverForever's fantastic digital tool, it's now so easy to get your business organized!
WaiverForever has been eliminating the physical hassle of waivers since 2010 and has been adopted by thousands of businesses worldwide. Join Jet Ski rentals, bike shops, paintball venues and so many other businesses in choosing an electronic paperless waiver future!
Sign-up takes less than 3 minutes, so start evaluating WaiverForever for your business now!
-----------------------
How can WaiverForever help my business?
First, envision that the entire waiver process is handled electronically, from creation to storage. Here are just some of the incredible benefits going electronic can offer your business:
1. All-electronic, fully customizable waiver documents. Get organized instantly! 
Create customized documents tailored to your business's needs within minutes: agreements, waivers and indemnity forms. You can format documents to collect customers' personal information such as signatures, addresses, phone numbers and emails. Want to know more about your customers? Instantly create short surveys to gather customer feedback through short answers or multiple-choice responses.
2. Permanent, reliable waiver storage system. Never worry about the stack of signed waivers again!
WaiverForever utilizes an industry-leading central storage solution also used by Dropbox and Netflix for maximum reliability. Coupled with our proprietary 24-hour automatic backup system, you'll never lose a single document ever again. 
3. Virtual organization of waiver documents. De-clutter your business!
Stay clutter-free by having all signed waivers saved and collated in one place, and exportable to a spreadsheet. Later, search for and retrieve a needed document immediately. If a printer is handy, make a hard copy.
4. Instantly find any waiver stored by searching. No more tiresome digging through piles of documents!
You can immediately locate signed waiver forms by searching for the customer's name, or filtering by a specific date. Say goodbye to the days of having to open up filing cabinets and rummage through piles of documents!
5. Deeper analysis of data. Get insight into your customers!
WaiverForever allows you to export aggregated user data into a spreadsheet file, allowing for further analysis. This makes it possible to quickly conduct marketing analysis, gather statistics on user feedback questions, and track customer activity. 
-----------------------
WaiverForever has been widely used in thousands of businesses all over the world. Jet Ski rentals, paintball ranges, non-profit volunteer programs, plumbing services, Stand Up Paddle Board shops and oh so many others. WaiverForever has dramatically reduced physical clutter and eliminated the all the potential hassle around physical waivers for all these businesses. 
So install WaiverForever now, for a stress-free waiver handling future for you and your business!

bluejetty:00072999:ios.description:
Text Summary helps you study, understand complex topics and remember key ideas. Turn books, documents, articles and photos into clear summaries, quizzes, flashcards and concept maps to support your learning.
Whether you are working, researching, studying, or just trying to stay informed, Text Summary helps you cut through the noise and understand content in minutes instead of hours.
You can summarize content from many different sources:
• Books and written material
• PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, EPUB, ODT, and TXT files
• Web pages and long online articles
• Photos and scanned documents
• YouTube video links
• Typed text or pasted text
You can type directly in the app, paste text from anywhere, import files, open links, or simply take a photo of a page or printed text using your camera. Text Summary recognizes the content and turns it into structured summaries automatically.
Text Summary is flexible by design. You decide how the information should be explained and how you want to work with it, depending on how much detail you need and what you plan to do next.
Available summary and content formats include:
• Extract summary
• Highlighted key points
• Bullet points
• Abstract overview
• Paraphrase
• Rewrite
• Keywords
• Translation
• Quiz
• Flashcards
• Concept map
• My notes
• Chat with your text or summary
Quizzes and flashcards are automatically generated from your own text or summary, allowing you to quickly test your understanding and reinforce key ideas without rereading everything.
With My notes, you can write, edit, and save your own notes directly inside the app. Use it to keep personal thoughts, add context, rewrite ideas in your own words, or store important takeaways for later. Your notes stay available so you can return to them anytime.
The chat feature lets you interact directly with your content. You can ask questions about your text or summary, clarify specific sections, explore ideas, or dive deeper into topics without leaving the app. This allows you to actively work with information instead of passively reading it.
Text Summary also includes a curated catalog of popular book summaries. These summaries are designed to help you understand key ideas, themes, and structure, making them useful before reading a book, after reading it, or when you want a clearer overview to decide what to explore next.
How it works:
Type or paste text, add a link, import files, or take photos of pages with your camera. Choose the summary format you want and get a clear, structured result in seconds. You can switch formats, refine outputs, save notes, or explore the content further using chat.
Additional features:
• Adjustable summary length
• Text-to-speech with automatic language detection
• Share summaries or export them as PDF
• Multi-language support
• Works with very long texts and large documents
• Easy sharing from other apps directly into Text Summary
Some advanced features, such as audio and video summarization, are available with an active subscription.
Text Summary is made for busy people who don’t want to waste time reading everything. It helps you stay informed, move faster, and focus on what’s important without overload.
You can start with daily free summaries.
A subscription unlocks unlimited usage, faster processing, advanced formats, and an ad-free experience.
Subscriptions:
A subscription is valid for 1 week, 1 month, 3 months or 1 year, depending on the subscription type selected.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
You can cancel anytime in your iTunes account settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of use: https://kreativityapps.com/terms-of-use-ts
Privacy policy: https://kreativityapps.com/privacy-policy-ts

A TotalPass é o app de academias e bem-estar que te dá liberdade para cuidar da sua saúde do seu jeito. Com um único aplicativo, você acessa academias, estúdios e modalidades esportivas perto de você.

Como funciona a TotalPass?
A TotalPass é um benefício corporativo para empresas que se preocupam com o bem-estar do seu colaborador. Se a sua empresa oferece TotalPass:
- Baixe o nosso app
- Crie sua conta gratuitamente
- Explore as academias e modalidades perto de você
- Escolha o plano mais adequado às suas necessidades
- Comece a sua rotina de treinos e bem-estar com nossos parceiros!

Experiência Orla TotalPass — um novo jeito de viver a cidade
A Orla TotalPass é um espaço físico aberto e gratuito no Parque Villa-Lobos (São Paulo) pensado para quem quer integrar lazer, esporte e bem-estar ao ar livre. Aqui você pode:
- Jogar nas quadras esportivas com agendamento no app
- Praticar exercícios ou relaxar ao ar livre
- Encontrar amigos e criar conexões sociais
- Aproveitar áreas de convivência, gastronomia e programação cultural
Baixe o app da TotalPass e tenha acesso ao melhor do esporte, treino e bem-estar, com experiências exclusivas como a Orla TotalPass e centenas de academias conveniadas no seu ritmo e perto de você.

bluejetty:00160559:ios.description:
The 4iiii app is a valuable tool to get the most out of the features of your 4iiii products and achieve your fitness goals. Using the app, you can connect to your 4iiii power meter (PRECISION 3/3+ models) and your Viiiiva heart rate monitor to both configure and update them. You can record workout data to FIT file format to be later uploaded to your favourite training software.
The companion Ride Watch app turns your Apple Watch into a cycling head unit. View power, cadence, heart rate, speed, distance, live while riding. Ride records your workout data to FIT file, and to Apple Fitness for closing your rings. Auto-sync to Strava keeps your activity feed up-to-date on completion of every outdoor or indoor cycling workout.
Multi-language: English, Deutsch, Nederlands, français, italiano, にほんご, español.
Features include:
4iiii app
Supported devices: 4iiii Powermeters, Viiiiva heart rate monitors
Record workout data (heart rate, power, cadence, pace, speed, distance, time, laps, calories)
Manage stored FIT files, upload to Strava
4iiii Power meters
Personalize your device name
Pair and unpair dual powermeters
Perform zero offset
Easy over-the-air firmware updates
Note: Available for iOS only (supports only iOS version 17.6 or higher)

bluejetty:00174515:ios.description:
The most advanced Sleep Helper on the App Store. With this app you'll relax and fall into a peaceful deep sleep. Getting a good night’s sleep is one of the most important things you can do. It can improve your health, lower your stress, and make you more productive at work.
Works without Internet connection and also in Lock Screen.
According to the National Sleep Foundation, getting enough sleep is directly connected to better health. So we know it's important to get a good night's rest.
White noise has been shown to not only help people fall asleep more quickly, but also it can disguise other noises that may wake you during the night.
Repetitive or ambient music is very good for falling asleep. What's especially important is that there be no dramatic shifts in the dynamics of the music. 
How it works:
• Select sounds and combine them to create a mix
• Adjust the volume of each sound individually
• Set the timer
• Lay back and relax
Features:
• 150 High Quality Relaxing Sound & Music Loops to Choose and Mix
• 14 Ambient Sounds
• 11 Isochronic Brainwaves 
• 19 Presets
• Thousands of combinations for sound mixes
• Individual volume adjustment to Unlimited Mixing Option
• Save Your Mixes 
• Timer feature to set a duration when you go to sleep
• Sleeping Tips 
• App runs in the background and while screen is locked
• AirPlay Supported
• Works without internet connection.
Want new sounds ? Write a review and let us know.
Only on the App Store

bluejetty:00090758:ios.description:
Приложение позволяет:
Проверить остаток трафика
Контролируйте онлайн расход интернета, минут и SMS. 
Пополнить счёт номера
Моментальное пополнение баланса и автоплатеж, перевод между номерами Безлимит, также предоставление обещанного платежа для разблокировки номера, чтобы всегда оставаться на связи.
Контролировать баланс и заказать детализацию счета
Финансовая информация о начислениях и платежах, анализ расходов доступны в разделе детализация счета.
Привязать номера близких к своему личному кабинету
Следите за их балансом, остатками трафика интернета и минут, с помощью безлимитного общения между номерами Безлимит.
Подключить eSim
Выберите номер для активации QR-кода, отсканируйте его с телефона, поддерживающего eSim.
Узнать все самое интересное в Stories
Показываем самое актуальное: новые линейки тарифов и услуг, акции и уникальные предложения специально для Вас.
Найти ответ на возникший вопрос
Нам важно, чтобы любой вопрос мог решить самостоятельно. В нем Вы можете найти любую информацию по своему номеру, а также найти ответы на часто задаваемые вопросы в разделе FAQ.
Круглосуточная поддержка
Служба поддержки Безлимит работает для вас ежедневно и круглосуточно, для решения любого вопроса, в какой бы стране мира Вы не находились. На решение уходит всего несколько минут. Чат не обязательно проверять в ожидании ответа, все обращения хранятся в приложении.

bluejetty:00061030:ios.description:
Easily and quickly backup your contacts with this app. Whether you are selling your mobile or purchasing a new handset you need to backup your contacts, this app makes this process easy by enabling you to send all your contacts and their related informations as vCard to your mail id. You can restore those contacts from the mail just by clicking on the vCard attachment and saving them. 
*************************
***** FEATURES *****
*************************
** Save contacts as .CSV or .VCF
** Save as vCard
** Mail contacts and backup them
** One click backup
** Save contacts as .csv in excel supported formats
** Exports all fields related to a contact (Name, Birthday, Email, Website, Dates, Postal Address, Phone Number, Job Title, Department, Social Profiles, Notes and many more)
** Set contact backup reminder
** Cross platform supported
Note: Contacts are shared directly from your device. No contacts are uploaded or stored on our server. So your privacy is always protected.
Our App can be used for free with Ads and limited features, however, you can purchase a Contacts Backup Premium subscription for the additional advanced features, and remove Ads.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
When you download our App you can opt in to a 3 days free trial for monthly and 3 days free trial for yearly subscription. Our App offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Contacts Backup Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING:
Premium Monthly: $0.99 / Month (3 days free trial)
Premium Yearly: $ 5.99 / Year (3 days free trial)
Read more about our terms, conditions, and privacy here:
• Privacy Policy: https://www.racersoft.in
• Terms of Use: https://racersoft.in/terms-of-use/

[The Ultimate BMX Rivalry Begins]
Touchgrind BMX 3: Rivals is the next evolution of extreme sports on mobile. Compete in high-intensity multiplayer battles, master a deep trick system, and explore stunning real-world-inspired locations. With new game modes, enhanced progression, and smoother gameplay, the ultimate BMX experience is now better than ever.
[Dominate in Competitive Multiplayer]

Take on the 12-player Trick Royal, where only the best trickster wins, or Bomb Rush, a high-stakes elimination race where the slowest rider gets knocked out. Every move counts—land perfect tricks, outplay opponents, and prove you’re the best.

Enjoy BMX like never before with Freestyle Mode, an endless single-player experience. Ride at your own pace, pause anytime, and explore breathtaking tracks while perfecting your tricks.

A completely revamped trick system gives you the freedom to chain tricks together for insane combos. Every move you make matters, adding depth and strategy to every session.
[Ride in Stunning Locations]
Explore new levels and tracks featuring some of the most breathtaking BMX environments ever created. From desert canyons to urban skateparks, each location is crafted to push your skills to the limit. New locations arrive every season and are free for all players.
[Customize Your Style]
Choose from a variety of unique riders and bike skins. Stand out from the competition with eye-catching designs and combinations that express your personal style.
[Constantly Expanding]
Touchgrind BMX 3: Rivals evolve with every update. New game modes, locations, bikes, riders, and seasonal events keep the action fresh.
From the creators of Touchgrind BMX 2, Touchgrind Skate 2, and Touchgrind Scooter.

bluejetty:00073151:ios.description:
Introducing Dual Space, the ultimate solution for seamlessly managing multiple accounts of your favorite apps. If you've ever found yourself constantly logging in and out, struggling to switch between different accounts, then this app is tailor-made for you.
Say goodbye to the hassle of juggling multiple social media accounts. Dual Space allows you to effortlessly log in to and manage multiple accounts on popular platforms.
But Dual Space offers more than just account duplication. We prioritize your data security and privacy. With our app, you can set a password to safeguard your accounts, ensuring that your personal information remains secure. Enjoy peace of mind knowing that your private accounts are protected within a dedicated privacy zone.
Key Features of Dual Space:
Log into Multiple Accounts:
Say goodbye to constant logging in and out. Use a single device to log in to multiple accounts and stay online effortlessly.
Accounts Security:
Set a passcode to add an extra layer of protection to your accounts. Rest assured that your data remains secure and accessible only to you.
Privacy Zone:
Create a dedicated privacy zone within Dual Space to safeguard your private accounts. Keep your personal and professional profiles separate for enhanced privacy.
Experience the convenience of managing multiple accounts seamlessly with Dual Space.
You can purchase an auto-renewable subscription to get full access. Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews for the same price and the duration period depends on the selected plan (weekly, monthly, yearly) unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can turn off the auto-renewal feature at any time by changing your account settings. 
Please choose from our standard subscription options below: 1-week subscription from $2.99; 1-month subscription from $9.99; 12-month subscription from $24.99. Prices may change depending on your country.

- Animated scenery.
- Relaxing atmosphere.

FORBES: "Best Apple Watch Apps for Health and Fitness"
Looking for an app to help you work out? SmartGym offers a beautiful, elegant and easy way. With an amazing and advanced algorithm that creates personalized training plans to help you achieve all your goals faster! It's like having a Personal Trainer and a Motivator in your pocket or wrist.
No matter which equipment you have available, SmartGym will always give you the best workout possible, personalized just for you and what you have. Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, improve your endurance, or just have fun, SmartGym has you covered.
If you're a beginner, SmartGym will help, guide and give you all the confidence you need to start working out. If you're already experienced, SmartGym will give you all the right tools in order to better manage your workouts and track your progress.
● Smart Trainer: Artificial Intelligence able to create personalized workouts that can be done at home or at the gym, based on the equipment you have, the muscles you want to target, and for how long and how often you want to work out. All tailored to your experience level (beginner, intermediate or advanced).
● SmartGym tracks your progress and gives you feedback and tips along the way, like adjusting the number of sets, reps, weight, replacing exercises or even suggesting an entire new routine.
● Track your muscles fatigue after each workout and throughout your entire fitness journey.
● Don't want to use our Artificial Intelligence to create your workouts? That's fine! You can also access over 130 pre-made workouts, carefully created by professionals and curated for you.
● Every workout always adjusted to the equipment you have available.
● Choose from over 700 pre-installed exercises with images and animations, ranging from bodyweight to dumbbells, kettlebells, resistance bands, and more. And if you don't find the one you're looking for, you can always add your own custom exercises with your own images.
More Features:
• Full HIIT Support with Voice Guidance.
• Full Home Workouts support.
• Add as many exercises to your routines as you want.
• Create custom timer for each specific exercise.
• Share your routines with your friends.
• Integration with Apple's Health and Fitness apps.
• Beautiful charts showing all your progress.
• Powerful iPad app.
• SharePlay. Work out together with your friends and family using FaceTime.
Apple Watch only:
• SmartGym is one of the most advanced Apple Watch app in the world.
• Standalone Watch app. No need to use the iPhone with you.
• Smart Trainer (no iPhone required). With just a few taps, you can get an entire workout created for you, right from your wrist!
• Keep track of your heart rate, distance and calories burned.
• Workouts count towards your activity rings.
• Use Siri to start your workout.
• Modify your exercise right from the Watch.
Personal Trainer Only:
• Use Augmented Reality to analyze your students' posture. (A12 device or later is required for this feature)
• Siri Shortcuts with Parameters. Quickly get your student's routines with just your voice.
• Great way to manage all your students.
Subscriptions Details:
The free version of SmartGym gives access to 2 routines, 3 workouts and 2 measures. Upgrade to our monthly or annually subscriptions to access all our features.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hour prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Terms of Service: http://smartgymapp.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: http://smartgymapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00099799:ios.description:
Sanctify: Made by Christians for Christians Who to Block Distractions, Stay Consistent in Prayer, and Grow Closer to God Every Day.
Have you taken a moment with God’s Word today? Join thousands of believers growing in faith with the top Christian app. Download Sanctify now!
WHAT IS SANCTIFY
Sanctify is a Christian app that offers app blocking, daily devotionals, tailored prayers, and personalized Scripture to help us grow in our faith and deepen our relationship with God. Explore interactive Bible study, spiritual journaling, Guided Chat and more. Note: Access to most features requires a subscription via in‑app purchase. The Lock Screen Verse Widget is free.
WHAT YOU GET
- Faith Lock (App Blocking)
Turn distraction into devotion. Faith Lock gently pauses apps like Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, and X until you've spent a moment in prayer and Scripture first. Choose which apps to lock and your daily prayer goal, then unlock them only after you've chosen God first. It's a simple, built-in accountability tool to help you break the mindless-scrolling cycle and build a daily habit of putting your faith first.
- Lock Screen Verse Widget
See a fresh Bible verse right on your Lock Screen or Home Screen. Choose daily or hourly refresh to stay rooted in Scripture at a glance. Tapping the widget opens Sanctify for deeper reflection. Availability depends on device and OS.
- Personalized Spiritual Guidance 
Start each day with personalized devotionals that understand your spiritual journey. Share what's on your heart, your struggles, questions, or celebrations and receive Scripture‑based guidance, practical wisdom, and personalized prayers that speak directly to your situation.
- Intelligent Bible Study Companion 
Transform Bible reading into meaningful dialogue. Access multiple translations and ask questions about any passage, verse, or spiritual concept. Get instant, thoughtful explanations that help you understand context, meaning, and practical application for your life.
- Contextual Daily Verses 
Receive carefully selected Scripture that speaks to your current season. We consider your recent conversations, prayer requests, and spiritual journey to deliver verses that provide exactly the comfort, strength, or direction you need.
- Adaptive Prayer & Reflection 
End each day with prayer prompts tailored to your experiences and spiritual growth goals. Journal your prayers, track God's answers, and discover patterns of His faithfulness as you build a deeper relationship with Him.
- 24/7 Spiritual Counselor 
Have deep theological questions? Wrestling with doubt or life challenges? Ask anything, anytime—from complex biblical interpretation to personal struggles—and receive compassionate, biblically‑grounded counsel that meets you where you are.
- Personalized Devotional Journeys 
Choose from our curated devotional series that adapt to your spiritual maturity and interests. Whether you're dealing with anxiety, exploring your purpose, or strengthening your prayer life, each plan adjusts to your pace and provides relevant spiritual nourishment.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Weekly Plan: $5.99/week 
Annual Plan: $49.99/year (includes 3‑day free trial)
Discounted Annual Plan: $19.99/year (60% OFF)
Sanctify offers both weekly and annual auto‑renewing subscription options for access to premium features listed above. The yearly plan includes a 3‑day free trial to experience all features. Payment is charged to your Apple ID/iTunes account upon confirmation. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the current period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited once a subscription is purchased. Pricing may vary by region.
Experience Sanctify today! Download now and start your journey toward a deeper relationship with God!

17 Mile Drive:

bluejetty:00132320:ios.description:
Welcome to the narrated offline driving tour of 17 Mile Drive in Monterey, California! 
17 Mile Drive:
Buckle up for one of the most picturesque stretches of roadway in the world! Roll your windows down and cruise along the Monterey Peninsula, taking in unbroken views of the untouched coastline.
All the while, we’ll fill you in on the area’s history and point out all the best places to stop and take a closer look. Learn about historic shipwrecks, the Mexican colony that once occupied the peninsula, John Steinbeck’s inspiration for his novel Cannery Row, and so much more!
See can’t-miss landmarks like the Lone Cypress, one of the most photographed trees in America, and walk along the shores of the gorgeous Pebble Beach. Whether you’re a history buff, a nature lover, or married to the sea, the 17 Mile Drive has something for everyone!
Are you ready to turn your phone into a personal tour guide? 
This tour includes:
■ Welcome to 17 Mile Drive
■ Custom’s House and Fisherman's Wharf
■ Cannery Row
■ Monterey Bay Aquarium
■ Lovers Point Park
■ The Kissing Rock
■ Point Pinos Bend
■ Asilomar State Beach
■ 17 Mile Drive Gate
■ The Links at Spanish Bay
■ Spanish Bay
■ Point Joe
■ China Rock
■ Bird Rock
■ Seal Rock Creek Beach
■ Fanshell Beach Overlook
■ Cypress Point Lookout
■ The Crocker Cypress Grove
■ The Lone Cypress
■ Pescadero Point
■ Pebble Beach
■ Stillwater Cove Access
APP FEATURES:
■ Award-winning platform
The app, which has been featured on Thrillist, was the recipient of the “Laurel Award” from the Newport Mansions, who use Action Tour Guide for over a million tours per year.
■ Plays automatically
The app knows where you are and which direction you are heading, and plays audio automatically about the things you are seeing, plus stories and tips and advice. Simply follow the GPS map & the routing line.
■ Fascinating stories
Be immersed in an engaging, accurate, and entertaining story about each point of interest. The stories are professionally narrated and prepared by local guides. Most stops also have additional stories that you can optionally choose to hear.
■ Works offline

bluejetty:00187621:ios.description:
GoShare is the best marketplace app for connecting with delivery and moving professionals on demand. GoShare's platform allows customers to find local, independent pros who can provide same day moving and delivery services.
GoShare helps businesses and people move goods faster and more reliably, from pallets and packages to furniture and paint. Our marketplace platform is capable of meeting your delivery needs with same day availability or scheduled service. Access a network of independent delivery pros with box trucks, cargo vans, pickup trucks, SUVS, and cars who can deliver your items on your schedule.
The GoShare app is perfect for people who need moving and delivery help and for businesses who want to improve their last mile operations and supply chain. Every project booked through the GoShare platform is covered by our comprehensive cargo, liability, and auto insurance policies. White glove service and assembly is available for most items.
Delivery pros on the GoShare platform will load, deliver, and unload your cargo. Even big and bulky items such as furniture can be delivered safely the same day. With independent owners of box trucks, pickup trucks, cargo vans, SUVs, and cars on the platform we can match you with the vehicle best suited for your project.
Say goodbye to long delivery windows, instead set a time that works for you. Schedule a pickup 7 days a week between 5:00am - 11:30pm with GoShare. Multi-stop routes are available for customers with several items that need to be delivered to multiple dropoff points. Select the Labor Only option if you just need some extra muscle for loading and unloading at a single address or moving between units within the same building.
The GoShare app makes it easy and convenient to get things done fast. In just a few clicks you can find a delivery pro who is ready to lend a helping hand for anything, from a small apartment move to a product shipment of pallets. Track the status of your delivery with real-time notifications and communicate directly with your pro in the app. After your project is complete, rate your delivery pro, pay through the app, and optionally leave them a tip for their excellent service.
Equipment such as a lift gate, dolly, appliance dolly, furniture dolly, lumber rack, and more can be requested. Our customer service team is available 7 days a week to help you get moving and answer any questions. Get live chat support from our team in the app or on our website.
Ways people use GoShare:
• Moving
• Furniture Delivery
• Store Pickup and Delivery
• Donation Pickup and Dropoff
• Labor Only Moving
• Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, Offerup Deliveries
Ways businesses use GoShare:
• Last Mile Delivery
• Local and Long Distance Freight Shipping
• Courier Service
• Less Than Truckload (LTL) Shipments
• 3rd Party Logistics (3PL)
Industries that use GoShare:
• Retail and Wholesale
• Food and Beverage
• Auto Parts and Equipment
• Construction and Home Services
• Industrial Supply
• Clothing and Apparel

GoShare is not available in every city, but if either the pickup or dropoff address is within one of our coverage areas we can accept your delivery request. If we are not currently available in your city we will be soon, we are always expanding to new areas.

bluejetty:00155589:ios.summary:
What is PayTix®? 
PayTix® has partnered with cities across the US to enable users to pay for parking tickets in a safe and secure mobile environment without any added usage fee other than a member cities convenience fees (if applicable). P
bluejetty:00155589:ios.description:
What is PayTix®? 
PayTix® has partnered with cities across the US to enable users to pay for parking tickets in a safe and secure mobile environment without any added usage fee other than a member cities convenience fees (if applicable). PayTix® has direct connections to member cities parking systems and is a partner of the cities listed in our supported city list. 
Key Features:
o Simple, quick ticket payment process
o Quick and easy ticket bar code scanning for fast ticket number searches
o Ticket Payment reminders and alerts
o Fast and Safe payment gateway
o Manage and maintain a ticket list of your ticket history
No App Usage Fee Commitment: 
PayTix® is FREE! We feel adding app "usage fees" on top of what you pay for a parking ticket is unfair and burdensome to you, the "public", and we are totally committed to keeping PayTix® FREE. We do not charge a "usage fee" to download the PayTix® app. Please note, some member cities may apply a "convenience" or "service" fee to transactions to cover the cost of providing services to the public.
Why use PayTix®? 
Since PayTix® is fully supported by member cities you can be assured that your payment is handled with the same security safe guards that are available to you on our member cities payment websites. We do not store your credit card data (anywhere) and we are fully PCI DSS compliant. When you pay for your parking tickets with PayTix™, you are paying with the same service that processes payments for the member cities today. PayTix® has native interfaces to our member cities systems. 
How To Use PayTix®?:
Simply pick the city that you got your parking ticket in and either scan the ticket number bar code on the ticket or manually enter the ticket number into PayTix® and press the Submit button. PayTix® will then guide you through the ticket payment process in 4 easy steps. If your ticket is not in the city's parking system yet, don't worry, PayTix® will setup simple reminders and a "Ticket List" for you to check your tickets availability.

bluejetty:00152054:ios.description:
Transform Your Morning Routine with Productive Fitness
 Start every day with a win. PushUpLock combines fitness motivation with productivity by locking your apps until you complete your daily push-up goal. Build a powerful exercise habit while reducing screen time and boosting your physical health while leveling up your character. 
 How It Works:
 Wake up, do your pushups, unlock your day. Your selected apps stay locked until you hit your daily fitness goal. The vision-powered camera
 automatically counts every rep with precision—no manual tracking needed. Alternatively, you can choose the floor detection method which is easier to use and more reliable. 
 KEY FEATURES:
 Smart Push-Up Detection
 Advanced pose recognition technology accurately counts your push-ups in real-time. No wearables or equipment required—just your phone's camera.
 App Lock & Unlock System
 Block distracting apps like social media, games, and entertainment until you complete your morning workout. Seamless Screen Time integration keeps
 you accountable.
 Progress Tracking & Analytics
 Monitor your fitness journey with detailed stats, streaks, and performance graphs. Watch your strength improve day by day.
 Achievement Ranks, Aura, & Levels
 Earn ranks and unlock achievements as you build your push-up habit. Compete with yourself and celebrate milestones. Earn aura and a visual upgrade by maintaining streaks. 
 Customizable Daily Goals
 Set your own push-up target from beginner-friendly goals to advanced fitness challenges. Adjust anytime to match your fitness level.
 Voice Command Support
 Hands-free control during your workout. Voice counting keeps you motivated and engaged.
 Flexible Lock Schedule
 Choose when your apps lock—midnight or a custom time that fits your routine. Perfect for morning routines or evening resets.
 Smart Notifications
 Daily reminders keep your workout habit on track. Never miss a day.
 Perfect For:
 Building a consistent morning workout routine
 Reducing phone addiction and screen time
 Developing discipline and willpower
 Improving upper body strength
 Starting a fitness journey
 Increasing productivity through physical activity
 Creating healthy daily habits
 Calisthenics body weight workouts 
 Why Push-Ups?
 Push-ups are the ultimate bodyweight exercise—requiring no equipment, taking minimal time, and delivering maximum results. They build chest, arms,
 shoulders, and core strength while boosting energy and metabolism for the entire day.
 Privacy & Security
 Your workout data stays on your device. No personal information required. Family Sharing supported.
 Start Your Transformation
 Join thousands building stronger bodies and better habits. Download PushUpLock and turn your morning push-ups into an unstoppable daily ritual.

Hunt enemy convoys, battle destroyers, attack land bases, and shoot down aircraft in this long-awaited sequel to the best-selling "Crash Dive".
Take command of a Gato-class submarine prowling the South Pacific in search of enemy shipping to sink.
Sneak past the destroyers and torpedo the transports, or surface and engage the sub-chasers in a duel with your deck gun.

* Optional crew management and detailed damage control (or let the computer take care of that for you).
* Optional upgrade tech tree for your sub (can also be left to the AI).
* Lengthy campaign mode.
* Random mission generator for deep replayability.
* Both randomly-generated maps and real-world locales including the Solomon Islands, Philippines, Sea of Japan, and more!
* Built-in modding editor lets you change every aspect of the game.

Pathbooks are Interactive Book Apps with images, decisions, and multiple endings in a diverse book library for all ages. 
Have you ever wanted to change the ending of your favorite book?

We’re creating NEW possibilities in the art and craft of storytelling where authors are limited only by their imagination. We love reading : )
PATHBOOKS
Be yourself and live your own story
www.pathbooks.app
