bluejetty:00015355:ios.description:
Sophisticated trivia game - exiting all along the line, Chip
Sharpen your mind .. a perfect game, Happy Gamer
In a nutshell: Simply great! Ifoneapps
The smartest, most interesting trivia out there. It’s designed to stimulate your brain with over 5,000 high-quality, challenging, and informative questions.
Each lesson tests your wits with 10 questions from 10 different categories. The difficulty level depends on you. Get an answer right and you'll move up a level. A wrong answer leads to an easier question. But you'll want to move up to improve your Knowledge Quotient, which is recalculated after every round.
More app features:
• Over 5000 questions = fewer repeats
• 5 difficulty levels, 10 categories
• “Improve Knowledge” trains incorrectly answered questions
• Explanations for every question
• Useful statistics and options
• American, British, Australian & international gameplay modes 
• Save game progress for 1-3 players
Improve your general knowledge with regular training. You can review category-specific statistics as you go to see how you have progressed after each quiz round. 
Our promise: the smartest, most interesting trivia in the App Store. But don't take our word for it: check out the user reviews!
The premium service is offered as a monthly or yearly subscription that does renew automatically and can be managed via the iTunes account settings. The costs for the premium service are either $0,99 per month or $5,99 per year. View the privacy policy here: http://thebinaryfamily.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00031282:ios.description:
The Water Eject app helps you fix your iPhone’s speaker by playing high/low frequency sounds + vibrations. 
So whether you've dropped your device in the toilet or took it for a swim, our app shall help you remove water in less than 7 minutes.
You can use the app in 2 different modes: Manual & Automatic.
The manual mode is for power-users who have knowledge about sound frequencies and know which frequency would be effective for their use-case. The automatic mode on the other hand is for people who don’t know much about sound & vibration patterns, but just want to remove water from their speakers.
# Salient Features
‣ Remove water from your speakers with ease
‣ Two different cleaning modes: Auto Cleaning and Manual Cleaning
‣ Speaker tester to check if your speakers are working properly

bluejetty:00175469:ios.summary:
Who Will Dominate the Wildest Wars?
Can you conquer lands ruled by the most powerful creatures? On this epic battlefield, what fate awaits the true Beast King?
Beast Lord: The New Land is a large-scale multiplayer real-time strategy game
bluejetty:00175469:ios.description:
Who Will Dominate the Wildest Wars?
Can you conquer lands ruled by the most powerful creatures? On this epic battlefield, what fate awaits the true Beast King?
Beast Lord: The New Land is a large-scale multiplayer real-time strategy game where you become the Lord of Beasts. Lead your animal tribes to explore new territories and rebuild your homeland in a world facing environmental challenges.
●Free Development●
Explore and Expand
Move freely across the new continent. Gather resources, build your base, develop your tribe, and fight to create a thriving home for your beasts.
●Encyclopedic Beast Archive●
Over 100 Unique Beasts
Choose from more than a hundred different animals, each with distinctive backgrounds and behaviors. Combine their special abilities to form a powerful, customized army.
●Realistic Environment●
Immersive Forest Landscapes
Experience breathtakingly detailed forests with stunning visuals. Traverse dense jungles and vast plains — each environment offering unique strategic advantages.
●Hunting Beyond the Walls●
Survive the Wilderness
Venture deep into dangerous forests outside your city. Stay alert as both predator and prey. Choose your battles wisely and manage your resources to achieve continuous victories.
●Megabeast System●
Command Mighty Dinosaurs
Bring dinosaurs back to the battlefield! Defeat wild creatures to obtain dinosaur eggs, hatch them, and unleash these ancient giants to dominate any fight.
●Alliance Warfare●
Join Forces for Victory
Form alliances with other players to strengthen your home and warriors. Expand your territory, launch coordinated attacks, and achieve ultimate triumph through teamwork and strategy.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Subscription Agreement in Brief:
Beast Lord: The New Land provides subscription services. Become a subscriber to enjoy exclusive boosts and privileges!
1. Content: Subscribe to gain daily access to multiple privileges and unlock various remarkable boosts.
2. Subscription duration: 7 days.
3. Payment: Via your iTunes account.
4. If you are a subscriber, within 24 hours before your weekly subscription expires, the subscription will be automatically renewed UNLESS you manually cancel it before then.
5. To manage and cancel subscriptions, please head to Settings - iTunes Store & App Store - Check Apple ID - Account Settings - Subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://static-sites.nightmetaverse.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://static-sites.nightmetaverse.com/terms.html
=======Contact Us=======
We provide considerate service to give a personalized service experience! If you encounter any game-related problems, you can contact us through the following channels.：
Official Line：@beastlordofficial
Official Discord：https://discord.gg/GCYza8vZ6y
Official Facebook：https://www.facebook.com/beastlordofficial
Official Email Address：beastlord@staruniongame.com
Notice!
Beast Lord: The New Land is a free strategy game, but there are still some items in the game that you can get and use for a fee. According to the terms of use and user privacy policy, you must be at least three years old to experience this game. Also, accessible network equipment is required.
Official TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@beastlord_global

bluejetty:00166482:ios.description:
Unwrap the magic of Paris, one day at a time with our virtual Advent Calendar, now updated for 2026!
EXPLORE PARIS AS YOU COUNTDOWN TO CHRISTMAS
Spend 25 days exploring the glamorous City of Light with our Paris Advent Calendar. Unveil a hidden surprise each day as you count down to Christmas. From iconic landmarks to delectable recipes, cultural insights to fun games, this digital Advent Calendar will ensure a truly Joyeux Noël.
DIGITAL ADVENT CALENDAR FEATURES:
While the traditional Advent Calendar is printed on cardboard with little paper windows – one for each day of Advent - our digital Advent Calendar app is much more exciting, of course, because the main Paris scene and the daily surprises all come alive with music and animation, including:
- Christmas countdown: keep track of the days of the holiday season with 25 numbered ornaments that unlock a daily surprise.
- Daily Parisian delights: Unlock a new surprise every day, like a fun activity or an interactive story.

bluejetty:00045569:ios.description:
Access the industry’s most widely used product, pricing and eligibility engine anywhere! Optimal Blue PPE (OB) Mobile provides key functionality to support loan officers and other mortgage industry professionals on-the-go.
The app allows you to track the Optimal Blue Mortgage Market Indices (OBMMI™) and receive push notifications for updates. OBMMI™ provides the most comprehensive, accurate, timely, and interactive analysis of pricing ever conducted in the mortgage industry. Calculated from actual locked rates with consumers across 42% of all mortgage transactions nationwide, OBMMI includes multiple mortgage pricing indices developed around the most popular mortgage products.
For Optimal Blue customers, you can also log in to price scenarios and save favorites to your dashboard for quick access. Scenarios can be automatically refreshed with a single tap, allowing you to easily see the best product, rate, price and more. This capability helps you understand how interest rates are moving on a given day, directly from your mobile device – no paper rate sheet required! These easily accessible scenarios can assist in conversations with prospective borrowers before an application is taken.
With the app, Optimal Blue customers can access the full array of pricing inputs you’re used to seeing on the web version of the Optimal Blue PPE, including any custom fields. This allows for an instant, accurate quote. Additionally, search results include the full granularity you’re used to accessing on the web. All eligible products and rates are displayed, including any adjustments, notes and advisories. Ineligible products are displayed along with an ineligibility reason.

bluejetty:00100381:ios.description:
Welcome to Magic Water Puzzle – the ultimate water sort and block puzzle adventure!
Dive into Magic Water Puzzle, where water sort satisfaction meets creative color block puzzle fun. Enjoy a refreshing mix of water sort puzzles, color sort water flow, and color block challenges — all packed into one relaxing and brain-stimulating water game puzzle.
Solve hundreds of exciting water sort and block puzzle levels, watch the color water flow beautifully into each block, and unwind your mind as you clear every color block. Each water sort puzzle is a new step in your calming journey of color sorting, water flow, and block puzzle logic.

Addictive Water Sort & Block Puzzle Gameplay
Experience a unique gameplay where water sort mechanics meet block jam puzzle logic. Move blocks, sort water, and clear color blocks while enjoying the satisfying flow of colors.

Explore endless water sort and block puzzle levels filled with relaxing soundscapes and vibrant color blocks that keep you hooked for hours.

Plan your moves carefully, connect the right color blocks, sort the water, and let it flow smoothly through each pipe. Every win depends on your logic and strategy.
Beautiful Visuals & Soothing Sounds
Immerse yourself in a peaceful atmosphere of flowing colors, shining blocks, and calming music. Perfect for fans of water sort and block puzzles.
Play Anytime, Anywhere

Slide and move color blocks to connect them with the matching water pipes
Fill each block with the right color water to clear it from the board
Complete each level and rise to become a true Water Sort Master

Enhances logic and focus while offering satisfying gameplay
Hundreds of relaxing puzzle levels with evolving color challenges
Soothing water sounds and visually pleasing water flow
Easy to play but hard to master
Train your brain, relax your mind, and let the color water flow through each puzzle.
Download Magic Water Puzzle now and become the ultimate Water Game Puzzle Master!

bluejetty:00126226:ios.description:
Looking for a great way to learn the Presidents? The Presidents app contains beautiful flash cards for all 47 Presidents of the United States. From George Washington to Donald Trump, portraits of each of the Presidents are displayed along with key information.
Quiz yourself by turning the information off in "Tap to Reveal" mode. Tap on the flash card to reveal the President's name, number, and years in office. It's a great way to test your memory. Looking for a little more challenge? Try shuffle mode where the Presidents are mixed out of order. You'll rattle off the Presidents by heart in no time!
In addition to flash cards, there's a full list of the all of the Presidents in chronological order for quick reference. Tap on a President to view details such as birth date, spouse, and Vice President.
The only thing you have to fear... is not being able to remember a President :)

bluejetty:00163374:ios.description:
Rail Europe is the easy way to buy tickets for train travel across Europe and the UK. We are the European railway specialists, providing the widest selection of tickets and passes - including the Swiss Travel Pass - for 25,000 travel destinations and 11,000 different routes in over 30 countries. This coverage is increasing all the time. 
Yearning for wider horizons? Start planning your next unforgettable travel adventure today with the Rail Europe travel app, formerly known as Loco2. 
HASSLE-FREE TRAIN BOOKINGS
Use our travel app to book your tickets quickly and easily for all the major railways in Europe on your iPhone or iPad. You'll also be able to find out about the Europe rail destinations we offer, thanks to our travel blogs, train maps and destination guides. 
TRAVEL SAFELY
Stay safe even before you travel by using our travel app for contactless bookings and e-tickets. Our travel app can help ensure safe travel by providing travel guidelines and train timetables issued by train operators. European trains are clean and safe - all Europe rail operators have stringent measures in place to guarantee safe, hygienic travel, so you can make your train bookings with true peace of mind. 
FIND THE CHEAPEST TICKETS
Our travel app can help you find ways to travel cheaply. You can even use your railcard for more travel discounts on cheap tickets. Decide which currency to use to pay for your ticket to guarantee the cheapest ticket price. You can even set booking alerts to make sure you never miss out on the cheapest tickets.
BOOK WITH OUR TRUSTED PARTNERS
Buy any train ticket from every leading rail operator in England, Scotland and Wales, France (Eurostar, SNCF), Germany (Deutsche Bahn), Italy (Trenitalia, Italo, Thello), Spain (Renfe) and international routes to Belgium, the Netherlands, Switzerland and beyond. Whether you're planning a European rail adventure with a pass, buying high-speed tickets for cross-border travel with Eurostar or Thalys, sightseeing on a shoestring in Spain with a cheap OuiGo ticket, or hopping between train stations with SNCF, you'll find all major Europe rail operators on our ticket booking platform.
•Buy tickets for leading European rail routes in Switzerland, France, Spain, Italy, Germany, Belgium and the UK
•Use our app for contact-free ticket bookings
•Check train timetables provided by European rail operators
•Pay in GBP, Euros, Canadian Dollars or US Dollars to guarantee the cheapest price for your ticket
•Check out UK Advance tickets for discount train tickets
•Apply railcard and loyalty discounts in multiple countries to ensure the cheapest tickets
•When you book your tickets, save your payment details
•International payments accepted when you purchase your tickets
•Set alerts for the cheapest tickets
•Access train tickets on your mobile
•View real-time data for UK (except N. Ireland) train timetables before you travel. Check if your train is on time and which train station and platform it departs from
•Not sure where to travel to? Check out our detailed train maps 
•Cancel and refund your train tickets

bluejetty:00175728:ios.description:
BUILD VOCABULARY FASTER IN 29 LANGUAGES
HelloWords helps you build vocabulary through fun word games, AI-powered stories, smart review systems, and practical everyday words. Whether you're learning English, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, French, German, or another language, you can make steady progress in just a few minutes a day.
[29 LANGUAGES AVAILABLE]
Learn vocabulary in any of the following languages for FREE:
English, Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, Vietnamese, Turkish, Thai, Norwegian, Polish, Dutch, Swedish, Hindi, Indonesian, Hungarian, Danish, Icelandic, and Hebrew.
Whether you want to learn English, improve your Japanese vocabulary, study Korean, practice Spanish, or explore a completely new language, HelloWords makes learning simple and enjoyable.
[LEARN THROUGH FUN WORD GAMES]
Vocabulary learning doesn't have to be boring.
HelloWords transforms vocabulary practice into engaging game experiences designed to help you remember words more effectively.
Features include:
• Drag-and-drop word games
• Word matching challenges
• Multiple-choice vocabulary quizzes
• Smart SRS-based review
Each game is designed to help you recognize, understand, and remember vocabulary while keeping learning fun and motivating.
[PRACTICE VOCABULARY WITH AI STORIES]
Once you've learned new words through games, it's time to see them in action.
HelloWords uses AI-generated stories to help you understand how vocabulary is naturally used in real-life situations. Learning words in context makes them easier to remember and more useful when communicating.
Features include:
• AI-generated vocabulary stories
• Personalized stories using words you've already learned
• Context-based vocabulary learning
• Story-based review experiences
Rather than memorizing isolated words, you'll encounter vocabulary inside engaging stories that reinforce meaning, usage, and recall.
[SMART REVIEW WITH SPACED REPETITION]
Stop forgetting the words you learn.
HelloWords uses a Spaced Repetition System (SRS) based on the Ebbinghaus Forgetting Curve to help you review vocabulary at the right time. By revisiting words at optimized intervals, you can improve retention and build long-term vocabulary knowledge more efficiently.
Words you've learned through games and stories are automatically scheduled for review, helping strengthen memory and support long-term learning progress.
[LEARN VOCABULARY YOU'LL ACTUALLY USE]
Unlike traditional vocabulary lists, HelloWords focuses on practical words and expressions that appear in everyday life.
Topics include:
• Travel
• Food
• Shopping
• Work
• Daily Conversations
Learn vocabulary you'll actually use when communicating, traveling, studying, or exploring a new culture.
[TRACK YOUR LEARNING PROGRESS]
After each study session, you can review your learning progress, including the words you've studied and the vocabulary you've already mastered.
[LEARN IN JUST 3 MINUTES A DAY]
Busy schedule? No problem.
HelloWords is designed for short, focused learning sessions that fit naturally into your daily routine. Just a few minutes a day can help you steadily improve your vocabulary and language skills.
Start building your vocabulary today and discover a more enjoyable way to learn languages.
Questions or feedback?
Email: hellowords@hellotalk.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.hellowords.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.hellowords.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00132149:ios.name: My Jump Lab
bluejetty:00132149:ios.summary: My Jump Lab is the most widely used app for measuring sports performance in a validated way, with more than 400,000 downloads in over 140 countries. It is used daily by coaches, elite athletes, physiotherapists, and researchers all over the
bluejetty:00132149:ios.description:
My Jump Lab is the most widely used app for measuring sports performance in a validated way, with more than 400,000 downloads in over 140 countries. It is used daily by coaches, elite athletes, physiotherapists, and researchers all over the world.
Unlike generic fitness apps, My Jump Lab is scientifically validated, with accuracy confirmed in more than 20 peer-reviewed international scientific studies. It allows you to assess performance with precision comparable to expensive laboratory equipment, using only your iPhone or iPad.
My Jump Lab uses the advanced sensors and camera of your iPhone or iPad to measure performance in a simple, reliable, and validated way, without the need for any additional hardware. For example, vertical jumps and barbell velocity can be measured in real time using artificial intelligence, directly from video captured with your camera.
With My Jump Lab, you can assess more than 30 performance tests, covering jumping, strength, sprinting, change of direction, mobility, wellness, force-time analysis, and more — all within a single, integrated platform.
TESTS INCLUDED IN THE SUBSCRIPTION:
◉ Jumping: CMJ, SJ, CMJ free arms, DJ, optimal Force-Velocity Profile, RSI-mod, horizontal jump, single leg asymmetry and 10-5 repeated jump tests.
◉ Velocity-based training (VBT): measurement of mean concentric velocity, load-velocity profiling, 1RM estimation, velocity loss and barbell trajectory tracking.
◉ Running and Sprinting: horizontal force-velocity profile, contact/flight times, duty factor, leg stiffness, leg asymmetry, pronation/supination, contralateral pelvic drop, linear sprint time with splits, curved sprint, horizontal deceleration, Sprint Mechanics Assessment Score (S-MAS), 5-0-5, 5+5, V-Cut and Illinois COD tests.
◉ Mobility: range of motion for ankle dorsiflexion, neck flexion/extension, hip flexion and internal rotation, shoulder flexion and internal rotation.
◉ Wellness: sleep, fatigue, stress and soreness questionnaires.
◉ Hamstrings strength: Nordic hamstring breakpoint angle and torque calculation.
◉ Force-time curves: real-time raw force time curves using the accelerometer.
◉ Motion capture: real-time knee valgus and squat depth measurement using markerless motion capture.
FEATURES:
▶ Import videos recorded by your athlete or patient to analyze their performance. Ideal for remote testing.
▶ Multi-user. My Jump Lab allows you to create as many users as you want.
▶ iCloud sync: share your data between your devices.
▶ History. Save as many tests as you want for each user to analyze their evolution.
Export your data to a CSV file. Ideal for research or academic work.
▶ Elegant and intuitive design (compatible with dark mode).
▶ Universal app: share your subscription between your iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Note: My Jump Lab works best with slow motion videos. The motion capture feature requires the A12 chip available on devices such as iPhone XR or higher or iPad Pro 2018 or higher.
Try the app for free for 7 days. A monthly, yearly or forever subscription is required to access all the app's functionalities and tests once the 7-day trial period has passed. 
What does the subscription include?
Full access to all tests available in My Jump Lab, as well as all current and future features.
When will I be charged?
When the free 7-day period is over, your credit card will be charged for the period you have chosen through your Apple account.
PRIVACY POLICY AND TERMS OF USE
Terms of use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: This app does not collect, store or share any of your personal data. 
Visit www.myjumplabpro.com/#privacy for more details.

bluejetty:00171790:ios.description:
Police work already gives you enough to think about. Finding the right summons, calculating overtime, checking your RDOs, or figuring out what sector you’re working in shouldn’t make the job harder. Summons Partner puts the tools officers use every day in one place - helping you spend less time searching, calculating, waiting, and second-guessing, and more time focusing on the job.
Quickly access summonses, violation codes, testimony examples, accusatory text, and other enforcement references. Our Police Overtime Calculator makes it easy to manage, categorize, track, print, and email your overtime while keeping a detailed history of the hours you worked.
Stay organized with your RDO Calendar, vacation and IVD tracking, and navigate confidently with the interactive NYC Precinct Map, including precinct borders, sector boundaries, address search, and department fuel locations.
Built with the everyday needs of NYPD officers in mind, Summons Partner brings the information and tools you rely on together in one place.
KEY FEATURES
• Summonses and violation codes 
• Traffic court testimony examples 
• Accusatory text 
• Police Overtime Calculator 
• Custom overtime categories and totals 
• Overtime slip printing and email 
• Paid Detail tracking 
• RDO Calendar 
• Vacation and IVD tracking 
• 10-hour, 12-hour, traditional and custom schedules 
• NYC Precinct Map 
• Precinct and sector boundaries 
• Address search 
• Department fuel locations 
• NYS Penal Law 
• NYPD Patrol Guide 
• TPO and Complaint Report / 61 narratives 
• 10-Codes 
• Department Phone Book 
• iOS Calendar sync 
• Countdown Widget 
Summons Partner continues to evolve with updated information, new tools, interface improvements, and features designed to make every tour a little easier.
MEMBERSHIP
Auto-renewable subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscriptions can be managed or canceled in your Apple ID Account Settings.
Subscription names, included services, features, pricing, and availability may change over time.
SUPPORT
Have a suggestion, idea, or issue? Contact us directly through the app or at: summonspartner@gmail.com

bluejetty:00152093:ios.description:
## CloudFocus — Cloud Focus for Deep Work
In a world filled with noise and constant interruptions, CloudFocus offers a different way to focus — one inspired by the freedom and clarity of being in the sky. Blending the ritual of a flight journey with modern focus tools, CloudFocus transforms every deep-work session into a calm, structured, and meaningful experience.
CloudFocus isn’t just another timer — it’s a new way to stay mindful, disciplined, and inspired.
## CLOUDFOCUS FEATURES
### 1. Personalized Focus Flights
Choose your ideal focus duration, prepare for takeoff, and enter a distraction-free session designed to help you stay grounded and productive.
### 2. Route Tags & Focus Tracking
Tag each focus session by category and track your progress over time. Review data insights that help you build consistent habits and understand how your focus evolves.
### 3. Task-Based Seat Options
Customize each session with different seat types, tailored for studying, working, reading, or creative tasks — making every focus flight uniquely yours.
### 4. Virtual Routes & Flight Map
Turn your focus sessions into completed virtual journeys. Unlock new destinations as you focus and build your own personalized world map over time.
## A STORY BEHIND CLOUDFOCUS
CloudFocus was born from real experiences — from moments of constant distraction, from the struggle to stay focused in a busy world, and from the belief that focus thrives when it feels intentional and meaningful.
Inspired by aviation lovers and deep-work enthusiasts, CloudFocus reframes focus as a journey:
a clear departure, a peaceful time in the air, and a satisfying landing.
Each session becomes a ritual — helping you stay aligned with your goals and energized by your progress.
## Subscription Information: 
Unlock all features with a subscription, available through in-app purchases. A 3-day free trial is offered, after which users can choose between a weekly or yearly plan.
- 3-Day Free Trial: Access all features at no cost for 3 days.
- Subscription Required: After the free trial, continued access to premium features requires a subscription (auto-renews weekly or yearly). Prices vary by location.

Email: support@budcreate.xyz

bluejetty:00121244:ios.description:
Your parents are out of town and you’re finally by yourself… So, what time is it? It’s EPIC PARTY TIME!!! Get ready, because you’re going to throw the sickest event of all times! In this clicker game, tap to get more guests while you upgrade your celebration!
Don’t be a wallflower! You will start small... But, put on your dancing shoes, upgrade your space and sound equipment and become a real social butterfly! You can bring a jello bar, a zero-G dance floor, a viking metal band to rock out this party and even a time machine! How awesome is that?
To totally burn up on the dance floor, you have to pay attention to the rhythm: sync your taps with the sick beats of the songs playing and improve the number of guests. Your party will bring the house down!
HIGHLIGHTS
• Follow your guests’ posts on social networks and see how your party goes!
• Drum on the screen and raise the number of guests per tap!
• Get over 20 party upgrades to drive your guests crazy, as arcades, laser ice sculptures, a moon lifter and even a time machine that can bring party relics of different eras to your celebration! Amazing!
• Upgrade your sound equipment to outstanding and really powerful ones, like Illuminati Amplifier, Dubstep Wizard and Hyperspace Echo!
• Get party vans to drive your guests to your party in style. You can even put them in a flying limo!
Seriously… Who wouldn’t go to a event like that? Let’s get this party started!!!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00161320:ios.name: League of Kingdoms
bluejetty:00161320:ios.summary: League of Kingdoms is the world's first MMO Strategy game owned & powered by users. On the genesis continent, all lands are owned and governed by you. You can actively own, develop, launch alliance warfares, and earn rewards by contributing
bluejetty:00161320:ios.description:
League of Kingdoms is the world's first MMO Strategy game owned & powered by users. On the genesis continent, all lands are owned and governed by you. You can actively own, develop, launch alliance warfares, and earn rewards by contributing to the development of the continent. Your strategy, diplomacy, instincts, and war tactics all come to live here!
Are you ready for a real strategy? 
Your strategy starts here. 
Various constraints of the resources, time, and distances make your astute tactics, penetrating intuition, and swift decision-makings shine on the battlefield than ever before. Less micro-control with more strategy. Welcome to the art of war. 
Your ownership matters.
You can own a parcel of land where the game unfolds. Invite your friends to your Land and start building a powerful alliance. The concept of ownership adds another immersive layer to the already engaging gameplay. Your active engagement will enrich your Land and attracts more kingdoms. 
Your treasure works like a charm. 
The unique treasures are waiting for the bravest kingdoms. These magical relics are passed down from ancient times. When you collect all pieces of the treasures, you can unlock massive magical powers that you can actively put to use. 
Join forces to a dominant alliance.
Full set of alliance features allow players to grow together: alliance chats with built-in translation function, officer roles, alliance researches, gifts, and more! Alliances can take down monsters, seize good locations to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements. Maximize your alliance power by leveraging members’ Land ownership. 
The siege of the shrine
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of the sacred shrines. Clash with other alliances and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in the campaign to capture the control of a shrine. Occupy the highest shrines and gain control of its surrounding territories. Your feats will be remembered for ages to come. 
The making of a democracy
Transparent voting and democratic governance process will always have your voice heard. As a citizen and/or an owner of the genesis continent, you will be empowered to voice and take part in important decision makings about the future of the game ecosystem. Welcome onboard to the self-sovereign society.

bluejetty:00150622:ios.description:
Curai Health provides chat-based primary care. You’ll have 24/7 access to your care team including unlimited visits with your primary care doctor. If you have a reason to talk to a doctor, we can handle it!
CURAI MEMBERS GET:
- Unlimited visits and messaging with your primary care doctor
- Care Team available 24/7
- No waiting rooms or stuffy offices
- Low monthly cost of just $29
- Available whether you have insurance or not
- Referrals, refills, orders and proactive follow up to make sure you're getting the care you need
SET AND ACHIEVE YOUR HEALTH GOALS
Everyone is different. Whether you want to lose weight, sleep better, regain energy, or have some other health goal in mind, our doctors and care team are here for you.
TAILORED TO YOUR UNIQUE NEEDS
We know you’re more than a diagnosis. So your doctor and care team will create a care plan that’s tailored to your unique health needs, lifestyle, and preferences.
QUICKLY RESOLVE YOUR HEALTH ISSUES
Start your first live chat as soon as you sign up. If your health concern is urgent, you’ll be connected to our on-call care team within minutes. For less pressing concerns, your doctor will reply to you in 24-48 hours. Your doctor can diagnose and treat you, ordering prescriptions or lab tests if necessary. All from the comfort and convenience of your home.
YOUR PRIVACY IS PROTECTED
Curai takes privacy and confidentiality very seriously. From the moment you register as a member and throughout your interactions with your care team, we have systems and processes in place to ensure that your identity and health information remain your own.
Ask about any health concern, including:
• Birth Control and Oral Contraceptives
• Urinary Tract Infections (UTIs)
• Sexual Health, STDs, HIV concerns
• Skin Problems like Rashes, Acne, Bites
• Flu, Cold, Fever, Sore Throat
• Vomiting, Diarrhea
• Sleep Problems
• Asthma
• Diabetes
• Allergies
• Persistent Cough
• Chronic Diseases
• Hair Restoration
• Erectile Dysfunction
• Cold Sores
• Pink Eye
...and more
Download Curai Health to start a visit with a board-certified doctor now!

bluejetty:00185544:ios.name: FarmVille 2: Country Escape
bluejetty:00185544:ios.summary: FarmVille 2: Country Escape is a casual farming simulation game that helps players who enjoy relaxing, creative gameplay build and manage their dream farm — by combining crop harvesting, animal care, crafting, cooperative trading, and coast
bluejetty:00185544:ios.description:
FarmVille 2: Country Escape is a casual farming simulation game that helps players who enjoy relaxing, creative gameplay build and manage their dream farm — by combining crop harvesting, animal care, crafting, cooperative trading, and coastal exploration in a richly detailed mobile experience. 
GAME FEATURES
● Plant, grow, and harvest dozens of farm-fresh crops to craft gourmet recipes and baked goods like apple pies and artisan treats 
● Raise and care for adorable farm animals — including horses, chickens, cows, and your very own farm dog 
● Explore a coastal farm map to uncover hidden treasures, rare items, and exclusive seasonal rewards 
● Join or create a Farm Co-op to trade goods, complete group challenges, and progress together with other players 
● Decorate and customize your farm with flowers, buildings, and coastal scenery to create a unique countryside haven 
● Earn daily rewards through mystery chests, prize wheels, and limited-time events 
● Play fully offline — no internet connection required to enjoy the core farming experience
What Makes Farmville 2: Country Escape Special
● Looking for a relaxing mobile game to unwind after work? Tend your farm, harvest crops, and bake recipes at your own pace 
● Love games with a social layer? Join a co-op, trade resources, and chat with farmers from around the world 
● Want a creative outlet on mobile? Design and decorate your coastal farm exactly the way you imagine it 
● Prefer playing without interruptions? FarmVille 2: Country Escape works completely offline, anytime and anywhere 
● Enjoy progression and collection games? Unlock rare animals, discover hidden treasures, and expand your farm across new lands
FarmVille 2: Country Escape is a cozy, feature-rich farming simulation game for mobile where players grow crops, raise animals, craft recipes, explore a coastal world, and trade with a global community — playable offline, free to download, and designed for both solo relaxation and cooperative social play. 
Additional information:
• The game is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
• Farmville offers subscriptions for in game currency. The subscription is billed monthly and automatically renews unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of current period. You can manage your subscription by going to your iTunes account settings after purchase.
• Use of this application is governed by Zynga’s Terms of Service, found at https://www.take2games.com/legal
• For information about how Zynga uses personal data, please read our privacy policy at https://www.take2games.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00035014:ios.description:
Share your images, not your secrets.
Black Highlighter makes it ridiculously easy to hide sensitive information in your photos and screenshots. Just swipe over text with the Magic Highlighter, and it automatically snaps to cover everything perfectly—no more frantic scribbling or worrying if you missed a spot.
Make redaction feel like magic.
The Magic Highlighter automatically detects and snaps to text, making it easy to hide exactly what you want—nothing more, nothing less. Use multiple colors to match different backgrounds or indicate multiple speakers. Easily import images from Photos and share them immediately when you're done. Available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, so you can redact no matter where you are.
Work smarter, not harder.
Want even more power? Ultra Highlighter unlocks automatic detection of sensitive information like names, addresses, and phone numbers. You can also add your own set of words to always redact automatically. Create custom Shortcuts to automate your redactions by automatically hiding personal details in screenshots instead of doing each one by hand. Use the document scanner to import and redact paper files using the power of the Magic Highlighter.
Black Highlighter is provided under a standard EULA. Learn more at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00183779:ios.description:
Enjoy Raiffeisen Smart Mobile - smart banking - wherever you are!
Here are some of the benefits of Raiffeisen Smart Mobile:
• You can open your account and become a client straight from your phone, 100% online.
• Intuitive interface: Easily find anything you need.
• Secure authentication and authorization: Use PIN, fingerprint, or FaceID when registering your device.
• Smart Hour - BNR exchange rates: Exchange between RON and EUR at the NBR exchange rate from Monday to Friday 10:00 - 11:00.
• Application personalization: Personalize the Dashboard using a simple "drag & drop" feature. Optionally hide the balance for your accounts or change your username.
• Instant payments: Send payments that reach the destination in 10 seconds. Available 24/7/365 for all banks enrolled in the instant payments system.
• Saving Box: Automatically save money with every card payment and earn interest. Choose how much to save for each payment.
• Smart Search: Easily find and repeat past payments.
• Control over your cards: Block, reissue, or view your card PIN with just one touch.
• Direct access to the Smart Market loyalty app: Get rewards such as cashback, discounts, vouchers, and loyalty points.
• Future payments: Schedule future payments, set up direct debit bill payments, or save them as templates.
• Access to products for your daily needs: Open current accounts, savings accounts, and term deposits with ease. Get a personal loan, Flexicredit, 100% online in about 10 minutes.
• Smart investments: Purchase Raiffeisen Asset Management unit funds if you have already signed a contract and have the required documents.
• Push notifications: Receive instant updates on money going in or out of your current accounts or payments made with your card.
• Pay utility bills: Multiple convenient ways to pay utility bills, including quick payment, barcode scanning, direct debit, and pre-filled payment forms. Top-up your prepaid mobile plan as well!
• Update personal data: Easily update necessary data directly within the application. No phone calls or bank visits required!
These are just some of the benefits offered by Raiffeisen Smart Mobile! Make sure to always have the latest app version installed from the app store to enjoy all the continuously added new features.

bluejetty:00093878:ios.description:
Baixe o app Nanda Benitez e coma de tudo um pouco, com boa conversa e curiosidades que ninguém te conta de forma simples, para você ter praticidade no dia a dia.
Pequenas coisas vão deixando nosso dia mais feliz e alguns demoram muito para descobrir.
Um cheiro gostoso vindo da cozinha, de pão fresquinho pela casa, abrir a porta do elevador e já sentir de longe aquele cheirinho de algo gostoso, que pode lembrar o sabor único da comidinha da avó, ou a comida inesquecível da sua mãe…
O melhor almoço de domingo, ou quem sabe o bolo de aniversário especialmente feito pra você?
Sentar e comer algo gostoso é um instante feliz.
O que nos faz seres humanos é o ato de cozinhar os alimentos ou combiná-los na sua forma crua de maneira harmoniosa.
Então vamos SER mais humanos e assim seremos MAIS felizes. Tudo começa na cozinha.
Aqui você terá:
vídeos demonstrativos rápidos e apostila no formato de revista com cada etapa.
novidades toda a semana
comunidade exclusiva
inscrições de eventos
suporte
Todos os meus cursos e aulas! Do fermento natural ao almoço de domingo.
Do meu jeito, com todos os detalhes, mas sem ficar uma aula chata! Tudo completamente autoral na maneira de fazer, ângulos e tudo mais.
Pães, bolos, comidas… Com glúten, sem glúten, pois quem come variado, come de tudo um pouco.
O cheio gostoso vai vir se você seguir todos os passos, e todos os pratos que estão aqui não serão mais meus… serão SEUS e da sua família
Além dos pratos, tem conversa boa, sinceridade e coragem de ser humano.
Pois nem só de receitas vivemos, precisamos conversar sobre muitas coisas do dia a dia.
Se cada um que baixar começar a colecionar instantes mais felizes a vida fica bem mais leve.
Baixe o app Nanda Benitez e nunca mais fique sozinho na sua cozinha.

bluejetty:00026557:ios.name: Ultimate Pool Battle
bluejetty:00026557:ios.summary:
PLAY EPIC HEAD-TO-HEAD 8-BALL POOL GAMES AND ENJOY THE THRILL OF FULL 3D GRAPHICS AND PINPOINT ACCURATE PHYSICS
Looking for an incredible 8 Ball Pool experience? Look no further! Play against live opponents from around the world and become
bluejetty:00026557:ios.description:
PLAY EPIC HEAD-TO-HEAD 8-BALL POOL GAMES AND ENJOY THE THRILL OF FULL 3D GRAPHICS AND PINPOINT ACCURATE PHYSICS
Looking for an incredible 8 Ball Pool experience? Look no further! Play against live opponents from around the world and become the King of Pool in the best full 3D 8 Ball Pool game! Compete in live multiplayer matches or play solo in hundreds of unique billiards challenges.
Some of the features of Ultimate Pool Battle include: 
FULL 3D GRAPHICS:
Play pool in FULL 3D with stunning photorealistic graphics. You can visualize every shot from any angle and even TAP-TO-ZOOM on your target and combo balls for pinpoint-accurate alignment. But if you prefer a traditional TOP-DOWN view, don't worry! That's still available and easy to use, too.
MULTIPLAYER HEAD-TO-HEAD BATTLES:
Compete against players from around the world in 1-on-1 matches and battle to the top of 2 unique Tour Modes. Compete on the 8 BALL TOUR, where you and your opponent will be matched up in a classic game of 8 Ball Pool. Or test your skills on the FAST BREAK TOUR, where you'll play Ultimate Pool Battle's fast-paced take on competitive billiards. Clear the table in as few shots as possible, and play at the same time as your opponent, with no time wasted waiting for them to make their moves!
MULTIPLAYER POOL TOURNAMENTS:
Compete at your own pace in a variety of DAILY TOURNAMENT CHALLENGES! Post your best score to the leaderboard and return later to collect your rewards. And, if your real life gets in the way, you can pause the game and resume when you are ready to play some more. 
INTRODUCING POOL ROYALE:
Stand above the rest and play an action-packed POOL ROYALE, where you compete against dozens of live opponents simultaneously in a timed multi-round event designed to test your skills under pressure. 
REALISTIC PHYSICS FOR AN AUTHENTIC EXPERIENCE:
You won't find a more authentic 8 Ball Pool experience than this! Become a trickshot master and learn to execute perfect curve, masse, and jump shots to help you score in any situation. If a shot is possible in real life, it's possible in Ultimate Pool Battle!
MASTER 8 BALL TRICKSHOT CHALLENGES:
Prove that you can dominate any pool table by solving hundreds of unique BILLIARD PUZZLES while earning prizes along the way. 
COLLECT GEAR AND UNLOCK POOL TABLES:
Customize your game and boost your performance with a massive collection of CUE STICKS, CUE BALLS, POOL TABLES, POWER UPS, and more. Mix and match gear to your heart's content... and at the expense of your opponent's ego.
So, what are you waiting for? Play Ultimate Pool Battle in full 3D and entirely for FREE… today! 
Need a little help? We are here to assist you: support@hypgames.com

bluejetty:00115141:ios.description:
Step aboard "Missing Hearts: Crimson Cruise", a free-to-play adventure where hidden object games meet dark fantasy. As Claire Malone, a fearless huntress disguised as a journalist, you’ll solve mystery games aboard a luxurious ship where no soul is safe. Search and find games will lead you through moonlit decks, secret lounges, and cursed cargo holds. To survive, you must find hidden objects, uncover clues, and face betrayal. Perfect for fans of unsolved mysteries games who crave suspense, romance, and danger!
Claire Malone, a fierce vampire huntress hiding under the guise of a journalist, boards the luxury cruise ship "Fortune's Dream", where fangs are sharper than the dress code. Her mission: solve a string of mysterious disappearances linked to bloodthirsty creatures of the night. But Claire isn't the only one keeping secrets. Ethan Cross, the enigmatic owner of the liner, hides his own dark truth: he is a vampire, determined to stop a rebellion within his kind before it spirals out of control. As a storm brews above and a cursed cargo sleeps below, Claire must face her fears, Ethan must confront his past, and together they must fight for the fate of every soul on board. With betrayal around every corner and time slipping away, trust becomes their only weapon against the Vampire Council - an ancient and powerful organization, hungry for much more than blood. They want to set a new world order where humans kneel and vampires rule the night. And on the ship, the first battle for the future has already begun.
· Immersive Vampire Thriller!
Dive into a cinematic narrative where search and find games collide with supernatural danger. Claire Malone and Ethan Cross must solve mystery games filled with betrayal, passion, and ancient plots hidden within the unsolved mysteries games!
· Uncover Dark Secrets!
Search for clues, collect artifacts, and piece together secrets in the atmospheric hidden object games. Find hidden objects to solve mysteries, discover twists, and test your detective skills in these gripping mystery games!
· Defeat a Vampire Conspiracy!
Board Fortune’s Dream and find hidden objects to stop an ancient plot. Mystery games fans will love the puzzles and thrill as you solve mysteries and enjoy the hidden object games challenges!
· Puzzles, Mini-Games & Achievements!
Challenge your mind with unique puzzles integrated into hidden object games. Every time you find hidden objects, you unlock progress in search and find games. Solve mystery games to reveal shocking twists in unsolved mysteries games that redefine destiny!
Board the Crimson Cruise now and prove yourself — completely free-to-play adventure!

bluejetty:00063633:ios.name: Lighter
bluejetty:00063633:ios.summary:
The most realistic virtual lighter: a Zippo that opens, lights and sounds like the real thing, a candle that lights up your screen, and a Concert mode that turns your phone into a light that moves with the music.
REALISTIC ZIPPO LIGHTER
•
bluejetty:00063633:ios.description:
The most realistic virtual lighter: a Zippo that opens, lights and sounds like the real thing, a candle that lights up your screen, and a Concert mode that turns your phone into a light that moves with the music.
REALISTIC ZIPPO LIGHTER
• Swipe up to open it, swipe down (or shake your phone) to close it.
• Tap to light it, with real opening, ignition and closing sounds.
• The flame moves and tilts as you move your phone.
• 10 flame types: classic, realistic and 8 HD flames (wild, blue gas, golden…).
• Resize the flame with + and −, up to almost the whole screen.
• Pick the exact color: hue, saturation, brightness and opacity, with live preview, 4 saved colors and a button to go back to the original.
• Sparks you can show or hide.
• "Flame only" mode: hides the whole interface and leaves just the fire.
REALISTIC CANDLE
• Tap to light it.
• The same flames, colors and sizes as the lighter.
• Skins wrapped around the wax so every candle looks different.
THOUSANDS OF SKINS
• Designs by category: Top, 3D, Animals, Architecture, Art and many more.
• For the lighter and for the candle.
• Blend modes: Normal, Multiply, Overlay and Soft.
• Random skin or no skin at all.
• Metallic finish with shine and edges.
CONCERT MODE
• The screen lights up to the beat of the music picked up by the microphone.
• 7 visualizers: Circle, Waves, Bars, Equalizer, Wave, Explosion and Cascade.
• Press and hold to turn the light on, release to turn it off.
• Choose the light color or let it cycle on its own.
• Marquee text with 4 fonts, 4 effects (pulse, bounce, stretch and shake) and preview.
• Recognizes the song that's playing and shows its title and artist.
• Send the visualizer to your TV via AirPlay or HDMI.
• Your music (Spotify, Apple Music…) keeps playing while you use the app.
AND MORE
• New glass-effect design on iOS 26.
• Built-in help for every mode.
• In 9 languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese and Norwegian.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.
FULL VERSION (monthly or yearly subscription)
• No ads.
• All HD flames.
• All colors.
• All Concert mode styles.
• Song recognition.
Light your lighter, turn off the lights and enjoy the show.
Privacy Policy: http://kissappsl.com/pages/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use (EULA): http://kissappsl.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00152731:ios.name: The Outsiders Fitness Tracker
bluejetty:00152731:ios.summary:
For people who like to spend time outside. Outside of their comfort zone.
The Outsiders comes with hand-picked metrics to help you improve performance in an informed way. Made for self-coached athletes driven by data and planning.
This is
bluejetty:00152731:ios.description:
For people who like to spend time outside. Outside of their comfort zone.
The Outsiders comes with hand-picked metrics to help you improve performance in an informed way. Made for self-coached athletes driven by data and planning.
This is not another "do more" fitness app. The Outsiders balances intensity with recovery. If you train with intent, want clear feedback, and see training as your main side project - this may be the tool for you.
*Created by the team behind Apple Watch App of the Year & Apple Design Award Winner*
For cyclists, runners, swimmers, and performance-driven athletes who know what they need.
▶ TODAY – KNOW YOUR READINESS
Start each day with a Training Readiness score based on the ratio of acute to chronic training load, combined with body metrics and sleep quality. This tracks the balance between recent training effort and what your body can handle, accounting for short-term trends.
This helps you:
• Select the right effort & intensity for the day
• Build steadily toward goals
• Avoid injury and overtraining
All factors affecting your Readiness appear in interactive charts (Sleep, Training Load Ratio - TLR, Training Form, Body Metrics).
Body metric history shows how training impacts recovery and adaptation. View data across 7 days, 4 weeks, or 6 months. Each view shows avg, max, and min values.
View sleep quality, duration, stages, and consistency over 14 days. Longer periods are coming.
▶ PROGRESS – TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE
See how your training load is stacking up during the training cycles.
• Balance hard training periods and recovery weeks
• Training Goals: Set short- and long-term targets and track progress over time
• Training Focus: choose the right type of guidance according to your goals - Polarized, Pyramid, Threshold
• Track your Endurance Fitness (CTL), Cardio Fitness (VO₂ max), and cycling FTP with clear trends.
Coming later:
• Running FT Pace
• Cycling Power Curve
▶ WORKOUTS – COMPLETE INSIGHT
All your HealthKit workout history in one place.
Garmin Connect supported. New workouts import automatically.
Weekly, monthly, and yearly trends with detailed charts, including training load, duration, energy, distance, elevation, and number of sessions.
Detailed in-workout analysis with:
• Key stats
• Zones (aerobic & anaerobic, traditional 5 HR zones, and cycling power zones)
• Breakdown (intervals, segments, and distance splits)
• Charts
• Advanced metrics: Efficiency Factor, Aerobic Decoupling, Relative Intensity, and Variability Index.
▶ APPLE WATCH APP
Key stats always a glance away: Training Readiness, TLR, Sleeping Heart Rate, HRV, Wrist Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Blood Oxygen, and recent Sleep.
Watch app complications:
• Training Readiness
• Training Load Ratio
▶ WIDGETS
Check Training Readiness, Body Metrics, Training Load Ratio, and Endurance Fitness on your home screen. 
▶ LOCALISATION
Available in 10 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese (Simpl. & Trad.), Japanese, Korean.
▶ PRIVACY
The app only reads HealthKit data on your device and never stores it elsewhere.
▶ DISCLAIMER
The Outsiders uses your HealthKit data and works best with >90 days of training history. If you’re new to Apple Watch or workout logging, it will need time to learn your patterns. Limited data means limited insight.
Crafted with attention to detail, by real, air-breathing humans.
Terms of Service: https://gentlerstories.com/theoutsiders/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://gentlerstories.com/theoutsiders/privacypolicy

Explore Creator Universe to discover posts performing above a creator's usual results. Research topics and creators, explore related content, and use Deep Research to find more. Save useful discoveries to Ideas.

bluejetty:00043803:ios.summary:
Meet Pip, your AI assistant with a face. Tap Talk and have a real conversation, out loud. She listens, answers in her own voice and looks at you while you speak, and she puts what you ask for on the screen in front of you.
WHAT CAN ONE AI
bluejetty:00043803:ios.description:
Meet Pip, your AI assistant with a face. Tap Talk and have a real conversation, out loud. She listens, answers in her own voice and looks at you while you speak, and she puts what you ask for on the screen in front of you.
WHAT CAN ONE AI DO FOR YOU?
TALK, OUT LOUD
No typing. Ask a question, think out loud, plan your day or just chat. Pip answers in a natural voice, in real time, with a face that reacts to what you say.
SHE SHOWS YOU THINGS
Ask for a recipe, a picture, a comparison, the plan for the weekend. Pip puts it on a panel while she talks: notes, lists, tables, images she finds on the web and pictures she creates for you. Zoom in, save or share anything she shows you.
SHOW HER THINGS
Pick a photo from your library or point the camera at something and ask. She describes what she sees, reads what is written and helps with what is in front of you.
SHE REMEMBERS
Your name, what you like, what you talked about last time. Pip picks up where you left off, so every conversation starts a little closer. Everything she keeps is yours: delete it any time in Settings.
SEARCH AND ANSWERS
Current information when you need it. Pip looks things up on the web and tells you what she found, with the sources on screen.
YOUR SCREENS, KEPT
Everything Pip has shown you stays in your history, so the recipe from Tuesday is one tap away.
WHY ONE AI
A FACE, NOT A TEXT BOX – Talking to Pip feels like talking to someone, not typing into a chat.
HANDS FREE – Cook, walk, drive, draw. Ask and listen, no screen required.
NO ACCOUNT – Download, tap Talk, start. No sign-up, no setup.
Privacy Policy: https://www.scate.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00085915:ios.description:
What did you lift last time?
You shouldn’t have to remember.
BurnFit lets you log sets, reps, and weights in as little as 10 seconds, review your previous workout, see how your strength is changing, and know what to do next.
From workout logging and gym routines to 1RM analysis, meal tracking, and body progress, everything stays connected in one place.
“What did I lift last time?”
“Am I actually getting stronger?”
“What should I train today?”
Your training history has the answers.
▶ Consistent BurnFit users log workouts for an average of 22.8 months
▶ Named one of Forbes Health’s “Best Fitness Apps” for 5 consecutive years
▶ 2M+ users worldwide
▶ 85M+ workout logs
Logging creates consistency.
Consistency creates change.
NEW FEATURES | AI DAILY RECOMMENDATIONS & SET ASSISTANT
AI DAILY RECOMMENDATIONS
Use your workout history, estimated 1RM, and muscle-group recovery to help choose today’s session.
• See a recommended training focus
• See estimated time, exercise count, and calories
• Get AI insights based on recent training and recovery
• Review suggested exercises and start right away
SET ASSISTANT
Choose 5x5, top set, back-off sets, and other set structures to get started faster.
• See a recommended main weight
• Build from warm-up sets to working sets
• Review suggested weights and reps
Spend less time deciding. Spend more time training.
LOG YOUR WORKOUT IN 10 SECONDS
Stop relying on memory or a notes app.
• Log weights, reps, and sets quickly
• See your previous workout at a glance
• Copy sets and load previous records in seconds
• Track warm-ups, bodyweight exercises, dropsets, and RPE
SEE IF YOU’RE ACTUALLY GETTING STRONGER
• Track weight, reps, sets, and training volume
• Follow estimated 1RM and strength progression
• See muscle-group training volume and fatigue
• Automatically calculate your Squat, Bench Press, and Deadlift Big Three total
Compare yourself with your last workout and see what to beat next.
AI WEEKLY REPORT & PERSONALIZED ANALYSIS
• Review weekly workout frequency, volume, and consistency
• Analyze estimated 1RM and strength changes
• Check fatigue and recovery by muscle group
• See what changed this week and what to focus on next
BUILD YOUR OWN WORKOUT ROUTINE
• Create custom routines for any muscle group
• Build Full Body, Upper/Lower, PPL, 3-day, 4-day, or custom splits
• Manage gym, home workout, and cardio routines separately
• Share routines or copy popular training plans
WORKOUTS AND MEALS. ONE APP.
• AI Lens: Take a photo to identify foods and analyze nutrition
• AI Text: Enter what you ate to create a meal log quickly
• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fat
• Compare nutrition with workouts and body progress
For muscle gain, weight loss, or better training habits.
SEE YOUR CONSISTENCY BUILD
• Review workout and rest days on your calendar
• Analyze weekly and monthly frequency, duration, and volume
• Compare progress over time
• Log up to 3 separate workouts per day
TRACK BODY PROGRESS
• Log body weight, body fat percentage, and muscle mass
• Add notes and search past entries by keyword
MORE TRAINING TOOLS
• GIF exercise guides and exercise search
• AI Scanner and exercise how-to information
• Friends, workout sharing, and global fitness QnA
• Backup and restore your records
FOR BEGINNERS TO SERIOUS LIFTERS
Use BurnFit to track 1RM, volume, RPE, progressive overload, gym or home workout routines, muscle gain, weight loss, meals, and body composition.

What will you beat next?
Start with today’s first set.

Consistency creates change.
BurnFit keeps your workouts, routines, meals, and progress connected—so every session adds up.

bluejetty:00068217:ios.description:
The most convenient service which connects taxi drivers and passengers in Maldives. Avas Ride works with private and luxurious cars, vans and taxis from the largest community of drivers in Maldives.
With our easy to use, sleek and simple app, booking a taxi is just 3 clicks away.
Reasons to Avas Ride:
· Fast: Find out your taxi booking status within seconds
· Simple: Using Avas Ride its is so fast and simple, that you spend the time you saved by using our app, staring at it in admiration.
· Convenient: Book now or schedule your ride to suit your needs
· Available: Book anywhere in Male’ or Hulhumale’
· Satisfying: Driver information, rating and reviews are provided to ensure you are happy with your ride
· Safe: With tracking information and driver details at hand, you will reach your destination with
peace of mind
How to use Avas Ride (Make sure GPS and Location Services are on):
· After you open the application, the application will automatically detect your location using pin
point accuracy and fill the pick-up location.
· 1st Click: Set destination (Either drop a pin in the map or write your destination)
· 2nd Click: Find your ride by clicking the button below
· 3rd Click: Once a taxi accepts your ride, take your time to see the driver details and book if
you are satisfied with your taxi.
· Once you book a taxi, you will be able to see where the taxi driver is and his estimated time of arrival
· You will receive a pop-up notification once the driver has arrived
· Make sure to leave a rating and a review about the experience of your ride once you have reached your
destination
Contact us:

+9607774713
https://avasride.com/

bluejetty:00129966:android.description:
There’s a party in space - and you’re invited! In collaboration with award-winning Hello There Games, Avicii proudly presents hit music game AVICII GRAVITY HD, where you can experience Avicii's latest and greatest hits through compelling and atmospheric gameplay. 
In fast-paced AVICII GRAVITY HD, Avicii's galactic hits merge with intense gameplay into a uniquely immersive experience - and YOU decide how it all plays out! Your progress determines how the melodies build up, while the environment changes to match the music. Swipe, push and power up your ships to maximize your rides!
Enter a flow-like state and ride through endless, artistic environments inspired by Avicii hits. Earn credits to unlock new ships, environments and power-ups. Better yet, you can access and immerse yourself in a variety of Avicii songs - in ways attainable only through this game.
Preparing to play is exciting in itself, as slot machines determine the tokens and power-ups you receive for your next ride. Also, the store is loaded with consumables, credits and hit songs. And finally, daily challenges and achievements unlock new ships and upgrades, and will have you coming back for more!

bluejetty:00129613:ios.description:
Welcome to Ball Slider 3D! 
Embark on an exhilarating journey where your quick reflexes and strategic thinking are put to the test. In Ball Slider 3D, your mission is to guide a ball along a dynamic track filled with twists, turns, and challenging obstacles. Master the art of pressing and rotating buttons to keep the ball moving and reach the finish line!
How To Play:
Tap the Red Button: Control red objects on the track. Timing is everything—tap to activate and deactivate red elements to clear the path for your ball.
Slide the Blue Handle: Rotate blue objects to create new pathways or remove obstacles. Slide with precision to ensure your ball stays on course.
Turn the Yellow Dial: Rotate yellow objects to navigate tricky sections of the track. Turn the dial to align yellow elements perfectly and keep the ball rolling.
Avoid Bumpers and Falling Off: Stay alert and avoid bumpers that can knock your ball off the track. Keep your ball balanced and on the track to avoid falling into the abyss.
Collect Gems: Gather gems scattered along the track to unlock new balls with unique designs and abilities. The more gems you collect, the more customization options you unlock!

America's best performing high-yield account.*** Built by intelligence. Join the waitlist. Members are approved on a rolling basis.

bluejetty:00119989:ios.name: Color by Numbers - Animals +
bluejetty:00119989:ios.summary: A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted bird
bluejetty:00119989:ios.description:
A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted birds. In the zoo we can view wild animals, such as rabbits, a fox, and a bear. Every time we learn more and more about these co-habitants of our Earth! Some of them creep along, while others run on their paws; still others soar through the air! Some prefer to live in burrows, some in nests, while others just live in the trees or sleep in meadows. You'll see huge elephants and hippopotamuses, small chameleons and frogs, fast lions and slow turtles - herbivores and predators alike. We invite you to get acquainted with these marvelous representatives of the animal kingdom on the pages of our game!
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

Every time we learn more and more about these co-habitants of our Earth! Some of them creep along, while others run on their paws; still others soar through the air! Some prefer to live in burrows, some in nests, while others just live in the trees or sleep in meadows. You'll see huge elephants and hippopotamuses, small chameleons and frogs, fast lions and slow turtles - herbivores and predators alike. We invite you to get acquainted with these marvelous representatives of the animal kingdom on the pages of our game!

Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining

Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

Produce high-quality performan
bluejetty:00071380:ios.description:
Rec'n'Share allows you to record audio and video along with songs from your music library and then share your performances with the world.
It digitally enhances the way you practice, record and perform music.
Produce high-quality performance videos easily.
Connect a compatible Yamaha instrument to your smart phone/tablet (*1) to simultaneously record video from your phone’s camera, stereo digital audio from your Yamaha product and stereo backing tracks from your music library (*2) (*3).
After recording, use the app’s editing functions to trim and balance the tracks.
Enrich your practice.
Pick a song from your music library and the app’s tempo detection lets you add a click, change the tempo and select sections to repeat. It’s practice made perfect.
The Audio Track Separation function, available in Version 3, allows you to adjust the volume of specific tracks (vocals, drums, bass, etc.) of your favorite songs. 
Enjoy practicing and recording more with your favorite songs in the background.
Share with the world!
You can upload your finished performances to YouTube / Facebook / Dropbox / Instagram etc (*4).
Whether you’re uploading YouTube covers or collaborating on recording original songs, Rec'n'Share lets you share your music with people all over the world !
(*1) Please check your local Yamaha web site for compatible instruments and connections.
(*2) DRM protected data can’t be played by the App. 
(*3) It is also possible to record only your performances without backing tracks.
(*4) The data uploaded to SNS is limited to your own original songs, sound sources, or those licensed from right holders.
https://www.youtube.com/music_policies
https://www.facebook.com/help/1020633957973118?helpref=hc_global_nav

bluejetty:00120470:ios.summary: “Piggy Maze Runner” is a collection of 90 maze levels for young children, along with a delightful fairytale storyline. Piggy is on a super mission, he needs to save the pretty princess by solving different labyrinth puzzles. He could really
bluejetty:00120470:ios.description:
“Piggy Maze Runner” is a collection of 90 maze levels for young children, along with a delightful fairytale storyline. Piggy is on a super mission, he needs to save the pretty princess by solving different labyrinth puzzles. He could really use your help to find the way out of the puzzle and confront the strong wolf or the scary dragon. There’s a plot twist though. He needs to play the Rock-paper-scissors game and win - in order to defeat the opponent and save the lovely princess, Miss Piggy.
This is a great logical game filled with labyrinths of increasing difficulty for kids. It is fun, challenging and engaging. This free game is based on a classic game that we all know and love - a family board game for kids of all ages. Are you ready for a challenge with this brain training game? Develop your skills in strategizing, spatial awareness, hand-eye coordination, problem solving and more!
Features:
* A simplified gameplay appropriate for children - just drag your finger from the start point into the direction that you want to move the Piggy and see as he goes on to the next intersection and waits for your clue again.
* Three levels of difficulty for children of all ages - easy, medium and hard with a total of 90 levels to play through.
* Awesome cartoon design of labyrinths with challenging volcanoes and flying birds, that are trying to make your mission very difficult.
* Best for helping kids build shape and pattern recognition, cognitive skill and fine motor skills.
* An enjoyable learning experience for kids and toddlers with vivid colors, funny sound effects and hilarious cartoon animations.
If you have any feedback and suggestions on how we could further improve the design and interaction of our games, please visit our website www.iabuzz.com or leave us a message at kids@iabuzz.com

Developed and continuously reviewed by our team of expert physicians and m
bluejetty:00179611:ios.description:
DynaMedex is a comprehensive clinical decision support solution designed to help clinicians make fast, informed, and evidence-based decisions at the point of care.
Developed and continuously reviewed by our team of expert physicians and methodologists, DynaMedex combines trusted DynaMed disease content and Micromedex medication content into a single integrated workflow. Content is updated daily through systematic surveillance of medical literature, ensuring clinicians have access to the most current evidence available.
Each topic delivers concise summaries, clearly graded evidence, and transparent links to primary sources and clinical guidelines, enabling confident, well-supported decision-making.
Now available with Dyna AI* for faster, trusted answers to your clinical queries. Dyna AI synthesizes DynaMedex content into actionable, concise responses with full transparency into source references.
What You Can Do with DynaMedex 
• Access integrated disease and drug content in a single workflow. 
• Review transparent evidence grading and source attribution. 
• Find clinically relevant summaries designed for rapid decision-making. 
• Stay current with daily updates based on ongoing literature surveillance. 
• Access content seamlessly across mobile and desktop experiences. 
Who Can Use This App 
This app is designed for: 
• Physicians and specialists 
• Advanced practice providers 
• Pharmacists and care teams 
• Clinical learners and trainees 
Why Clinicians Choose DynaMedex: DynaMedex helps clinicians navigate complex decisions with clarity and confidence by combining trusted disease and medication content with transparent, evidence-based guidance.
*Dyna AI availability is dependent on your subscription and access level.

bluejetty:00069338:ios.description:

This mobile training helps you prepare for your DMV Permit Test. The best thing about the app is its accessibility and the completeness of the information provided. Build strength while reducing joint pain, supporting testosterone levels, and preventing muscle loss.

Chair and walking sessions help you stay active, confident, and independent at home.

BUILT FOR MEN OVER 40

Strong at any age. Fit for life.

bluejetty:00079993:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate destination for all billiards and pool enthusiasts! Featuring stunning 3D graphics and realistic pool physics, this game is designed to bring you the most immersive pocket billiards experience on your device. 
Dive into the world of cue sports with a variety of exciting modes, including the classic 8-Ball game, strategic Snooker, and thrilling 9-Ball challenges. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, our game offers something for every level of skill.
Practice against a smart AI to hone your skills, or challenge players from around the globe in exciting online multiplayer matches. Our game is fully optimized for iPad, providing an exceptional visual and tactile experience with responsive touch controls that make gameplay smooth and enjoyable. Plus, with our offline mode, you can play anytime, anywhere — no internet connection needed!
Key Features:
- Realistic billiards physics for an authentic table experience.
- Multiple game modes: Classic 8-Ball, Snooker, and 9-Ball to keep you engaged.
- Stunning 3D graphics that bring the felt and balls to life.
- Online multiplayer: Challenge players worldwide in competitive real-time matches.
- Play offline: No internet? No problem! Enjoy the game even without connectivity.
- Free to download and play, with optional features to enhance your gameplay.
Designed perfectly for iPad, maximizing the gaming experience with superior graphics and smooth controls.
This is not just about knocking balls into pockets; it’s about strategy, skill, and a little bit of luck. Perfect your cue shots, plan your angles, and adjust your power to dominate the table. Whether you’re nailing a tricky snooker shot or going for that satisfying eight-ball finish, our game delivers an exciting and rewarding experience. 
So chalk up your cue stick, refine your angles, and get ready to strike! Download the game now and join the thrilling world of billiards right on your iPad. Whether you’re in for a quick break or a long snooker marathon, we’ve got the table ready for you. Rack ’em up!

Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions to understand how we protect your data and ensure a safe gaming experience.

bluejetty:00150752:ios.description:

Alloc8 mobile, the dedicated mobile application for the Alloc8 platform, allows scheduled workers to access everything they need to know about their upcoming jobs.  • View upcoming job schedule
 • View job details including other crew members, individual shift notes, equipment and resources
 • Get directions to job locations (via native maps application)
 • Access important job documents such as SWMS, Plans, and Permits
 • Sign and submit timesheets
 • View past jobs
 • Real-time reporting back to the web platform
