bluejetty:00127952:ios.description:
The AirMini™ by ResMed app is your personal sleep therapy assistant. With the AirMini's built-in wireless Bluetooth® technology, you can set up therapy, change comfort settings and track your sleep all on your smart device.
Developed by ResMed, the world's leading provider of connected healthcare solutions, the AirMini app helps you stay in control and informed. To learn more, visit ResMed.com/AirMini.
Note: This app does not support ResMed AirSense 10 or AirCurve 10 devices.
SMARTPHONE THERAPY
Starting and stopping therapy is close to effortless with setup and operation all managed on your smart device. 
SLEEP TRACKING
Daily statistics on usage hours, mask seal and events per hour are recorded for you to review after every sleep. 
PERSONAL DASHBOARD
See how well you slept with a snapshot of your most recent therapy session posted on your dashboard. 
COMFORT SETTINGS
Therapy pressure is set by your provider, but with adjustable comfort settings, your experience can be tailored to suit you.
GUIDED SETUP
Machine and mask setup tools guide you step by step from the very first day of your therapy journey. 
SHARE DATA
The 'Upload Data to Cloud' function allows you to easily share your therapy data with your provider or physician.
TEST DRIVE
The Test Drive tutorial gives you a chance to try out what therapy feels like and helps troubleshoot for mask leak, so that your first night goes as smoothly as possible.

bluejetty:00175427:ios.description:
------ Product Features ------
*Caixin Weekly Digital Edition
For decision-makers and management in the fields of finance, economy, industry and investment, it focuses on financial information in economy, finance, industry and other social fields, focuses on reform and opening up, is based on financial information, and provides objective and timely exclusive reports, in-depth investigations, and authoritative analyses.
*Financial News
It provides accurate and timely records of the rise and fall of important figures in the financial sector; and insightful analysis of the forces that dominate the fate of figures and drive financial events. Updated every weekday, with no limit on breaking news.
*Caixin Time, Caixin's ace video program.
Caixin Time" is a high-profile video program featuring conversations with global political, business and academic figures. Exclusive interviews with domestic and foreign dignitaries such as Kissinger, Lee Hsien Loong, Carrie Lam, and Lou Jiwei; famous entrepreneurs such as Musk, Wang Shi, Lei Jun, Liu Qiangdong, Dong Mingzhu, Cao Dewang, Li Shufu, and Zhang Chaoyang; and senior economists such as Wu Jinglian, Zhu Min, Summers, and Stiglitz.
*Friday at 7pm
Every Friday night at 7:00 pm, the audio program brings together the key news analysis of the week, and sees the big trends in the big events.
*Caixin's visual presentation.
Caixin Vision is a visual program that captures moments with a camera and shows the shadow of the times. Each issue features a combination of 6-8 pages of photographs to present life in all its forms.
------ More auxiliary functions ------
* AI Voice Broadcasting
AI intelligent anchor "Caixiaoxin" provides you with comprehensive content coverage. Multiple speed, timer, and male and female voice anchor functions can be selected at will, so you can listen to the new financial information freely.
*One-click sharing, read to more people
Forward the article or generate a poster to grab a limited number of free readings. Share in-depth articles with your friends.

-Caixin Data Express Lite ￥1298
-Caixin Data Express Pro ￥1998

You can cancel auto-renew by adjusting “subscription” settings of your iTunes/Apple ID. Please note that adjustment must be made at least 24 hours before the expiration of the current subscription period.

bluejetty:00094972:ios.description:
Dirt Trackin’ 3 brings full-throttle American dirt oval racing to your phone.
Slide it through the corners, pound the cushion, battle through traffic, build your own race team, and customize your car exactly how you want it.
From local-style short tracks to high-speed dirt ovals, Dirt Trackin’ 3 is built for players who want real dirt racing energy, real drivers, real classes, and a whole lot of sideways chaos.
FEATURES
27 Dirt Tracks
Race across a growing lineup of officially licensed tracks, re-imagined Dirt Trackin’ favorites, and brand-new venues built for close racing, big sliders, and full-send moments.
5 Real-World Classes
Jump into Super Late Models, Crate Late Models, Modifieds, B-Mods, and Street Stocks.
170+ Real-World Drivers
Race as approved real-world drivers from across the dirt racing world.
Paint Booth Customization
Build your own look with a powerful free-range Paint Booth. Paint individual parts, place numbers and logos where you want, use real-world sponsor decals, and create cars that actually feel like yours.
Dynamic Dirt Racing Feel
Track conditions change across the night. Time Trials, Heats, and Mains each have their own grip level, forcing you to adapt instead of running the same lap every race.
Career Mode
Start in Street Stocks and work your way toward the top Super Late Model seasons. Earn money, upgrade your car, sign sponsors, hire crew members, unlock customizations, and build your team from the bottom up.
Race Weekends, Hot Laps, and Single Races
Run quick laps, chase ghosts, jump into single races, or go through full race weekends.
Multiplayer Racing
Take the action online with up to 20 players and battle it out against the Dirt Trackin’ community.
Race Replays
Relive the chaos from multiple camera angles, including in-car, on-car, static cameras, director mode, and TV-style views.
Controls and Setups
Choose your control style, adjust assists, and fine-tune your car setup to match how you like to drive.
BUILT FOR DIRT RACING FANS
Dirt Trackin’ 3 is for the players who love sliders, cushion runs, door-to-door racing, custom cars, and the kind of finishes that make you want to run it back immediately.

bluejetty:00098611:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00098611:ios.description:
Cube Color Escape is a challenging collection of logic puzzles that will test your brain and keep you hooked for hours. If you enjoy logic games, cube escape challenges, or creative hole games, then this is the perfect cube game for you.
Your mission is simple but addictive: guide every color cube into its matching color hole and fill them. Each move requires strategy, timing, and smart thinking. One wrong drop and the path may be blocked, so plan carefully and escape the puzzle before it’s too late.
How to Play
- Tap and drop all the color cubes into the correct holes
- Match colors and make sure each cube lands in its proper fancy hole
- Avoid filling the wrong slots or you’ll run out of space
- Think ahead like in true logic games and solve the puzzle step by step
- Beat the level by clearing every cube without getting stuck
Features You’ll Love
- Addictive logic puzzles designed for all skill levels
- Simple one-finger controls make it easy to play anytime
- Satisfying cube escape mechanics with colorful challenges
- Unique combination of hole and fill gameplay with tricky twists
- A relaxing yet brain-teasing people game experience
- Vibrant design that makes every cube jam level fun and rewarding
Why Play Cube Color Escape?
Unlike ordinary hole games, this puzzle combines color cube drops, logic puzzles, and escape mechanics to create an amazing challenge. Each level feels fresh, testing your ability to plan, strategize, and outsmart the puzzle.
If you’re a fan of logic games, cube jam puzzles, or want a new kind of color hole challenge, this game delivers endless fun. Every drop matters, every move counts, and every completed puzzle feels like a true brain victory.
Whether you have just a few minutes or want to play for hours, Cube Color Escape offers the perfect balance between relaxation and mental challenge.
Start your journey with Cube Color Escape and enjoy an addictive puzzle game. Drop every color cube into its fancy hole, escape tricky jams, and prove you’re a true master of logic puzzles.

bluejetty:00014000:ios.description:
Looking for a free resume builder app?
CV Engineer helps you create ATS-friendly resumes, improve them with AI, and check them for common mistakes before applying for jobs.
Featuring helpful examples, advice, and resume templates. All written by a professional recruiter. We ensure you have the perfect CV to impress employers and get job interviews.
- Trusted by 6,100,000 job seekers to build resumes and find work
- All examples and writing advice were created by a professional recruiter
HOW IT WORKS
Getting started is easy. Choose a professional CV template and then fill it with your information. That's it! We provide examples to help you.
Our resume creator is perfect for students, graduates, career changers, professionals, and job seekers in every industry.
FEATURES:
* PROFESSIONAL RESUME TEMPLATES
Our CV templates were designed by a recruiter to be ATS-friendly. They’re optimized for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) used by employers. Create resumes that are easy for hiring managers and recruitment software to read.
* RESUME SCAN
Use our resume checker to identify common mistakes before you apply. Resume Scan analyzes your CV and provides actionable feedback to improve readability, professionalism, and ATS compatibility.
Resume Scan helps identify issues that could reduce your chances of getting job interviews.
* AI RESUME WRITING ASSISTANT
Improve your CV with AI-powered suggestions. Rewrite work experience, personal statements, and skills to sound more professional. Includes spelling and grammar correction.
* IMPORT YOUR EXISTING RESUME
Import an existing resume from PDF or Word in seconds and continue editing it inside our CV maker.
* EASY RESUME EDITING OPTIONS AND CV WRITING TOOLS
Quickly write and edit your CV. Our resume builder handles the formatting. Use bullet points to present your experience in an easy-to-read format.
* CREATE CUSTOM CV SECTIONS
Add sections to your resume with custom titles. Perfect if you have experience that doesn’t fit into traditional CV sections.
* STEP-BY-STEP ADVICE ON HOW TO WRITE EACH RESUME SECTION
Advice from a professional recruiter on how to write each section of your CV. Make your resume easy-to-read for hiring managers.
* EXAMPLE CV SECTIONS TO GIVE YOU IDEAS
Looking for inspiration? We have examples to give you ideas on what to include.
Example resume sections for healthcare professionals, nurses, construction workers, data scientists, software developers, students, graduates, executives, and sales managers. Our intelligent resume creator can help regardless of your profession!
* DOWNLOAD AND SHARE YOUR NEW PDF RESUME
Easily download and share your CV in PDF format. Save to your device or share as an email attachment. Send your curriculum vitae to your contacts for feedback.
* WRITE YOUR RESUME IN ANOTHER LANGUAGE
Our resume editor supports English, Spanish, Dutch, German, French, Indonesian, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, and Turkish.
* OTHER FEATURES
- Dark mode
- Edit font sizes and margins on your CV
- Add your photo to your CV
- Job search
- Resignation letter maker
CV Engineer makes it easy to create resumes. Our resume builder produces a professional curriculum vitae using your choice of template.
WHY WE BUILT CV ENGINEER
CV Engineer was created by a professional recruiter to help job seekers build better resumes and get more interviews.
Our resume maker has all the features you need to create a CV that hiring managers can easily read.
CV ENGINEER IN THE PRESS
Our free CV generator has been featured by Wired, CNET, and Popular Science.
FEEDBACK AND CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Want to give feedback on our resume maker? Email us at info@cvengineer.io

bluejetty:00061322:ios.description:
Easy, fast, personal: «Intesa Sanpaolo Mobile» is the Intesa Sanpaolo app for the everyday banking. You can use it even if you don’t have an account in Intesa Sanpaolo.
With «Intesa Sanpaolo Mobile» you can:
• Consult your account and cards 
• Make recharges, pay bills and other payments
• Pay Italian bank transfers, overseas and instant bank transfers
• Manage your credit, debit and prepaid cards, setting limits, geolocation options, linked virtual cards and suspending or blocking cards in case of emergency.
• Receive customized assistance from the online branch simply with a «shake» in every moment of navigation;
• Pay in partner’s shops with BANCOMAT Pay® and exchange money in real time: you just need a mobile phone number to send or receive money in few seconds!
• With the function «SOS withdrawal» you can allow a person you know to withdraw a small amount of money in an emergency situation, without using the card, from every ATM of the Intesa Sanpaolo Group.
• Support environmental and social projects by donating with For Funding
Designed for those who are always on the move, with the app “Intesa Sanpaolo Mobile” you always bring the bank in your pockets.
App services are available within the limits and conditions provided in the My Key contract of the Group Intesa Sanpaolo
Accessibility Declaration: https://group.intesasanpaolo.com/it/dichiarazione-accessibilita/dichiarazione-accessibilita-mobileisp-ios

Embark on a journey into "Last Life," a game where the sandbox genre is elevated by the integration of tactical shooter gameplay. This is the quintessential sandbox experience, providing players with unprecedented freedom to experiment and interact with a dynamic world that reacts to every decision.

bluejetty:00128999:ios.summary: LooLoo Kids send their greetings and invite all the kids to learn and play! Johny and his friends know how important it is to spend time usefully and have fun at the same time. Your kid is going to explore the world around us and learn lots
bluejetty:00128999:ios.description:
LooLoo Kids send their greetings and invite all the kids to learn and play! Johny and his friends know how important it is to spend time usefully and have fun at the same time. Your kid is going to explore the world around us and learn lots of new things. An interesting educational game with the favorite songs of LooLoo Kids guarantees all girls and boys a good mood!
What's there for kids in the educational minigames?
- An island with musician frogs where the player needs to assemble their music band and organize a real concert. It's perfect for getting to know musical notes and instruments!
- Jigsaw puzzles with animals. Putting together pictures is fun and easy so even the smallest kids can handle it!
- The bus from the famous song: in the minigame, the player is to take passengers to their destinations through an obstacle course!
- Riding down the slide with Johny and his friends, but before that, the player needs to collect the necessary items - an interesting task to develop dexterity!
- A real photoshoot! Attention here, no character should be missed!
- Match 3, a puzzle for small kids where one needs to be smart and logical. LooLoo Kids world will not leave anyone unadmired!
LEARN
The game will develop dexterity in your kid, as well as improve their memory while getting them acquainted with the world around them. Just like with LooLoo Kids songs, no one will get bored in this game! Learning with LooLoo Kids is fun and easy!
HAVE FUN
What can be better than exploring the outer world with songs and games? Johny and his friends are ready to ride down the slide on their sleds, play the guitar and get to know animals. A bright and intuitive game interface is something every kid will like!
LooLoo Kids world is full of fun educational games with popular kids songs. Download the app, join the LooLoo Kids Club and give your kid unforgettable impressions with Johny and his friends. Educational games for kids have never been so engaging!

bluejetty:00022499:ios.description:
Measure and track your shooting accuracy with just your iPhone. This app replaces your measuring calipers, range journal, training planner, zeroing targets and more!
Get instant accuracy metric feedback after each shot group you track. Manage progress with over 100+ actionable shooting accuracy insights. Access all features with range session upgrade packages or get unlimited range sessions with a pro subscription. 
Bye-Bye Measuring Calipers
The 'Ballistics Cam' replaces calipers as the modern way of measuring your shot groups. View the target with your iPhone camera and tap to mark the point of aim and hits. Measurements are calculated automatically delivering you shot group analytics, accuracy metrics, and more. Works on any target. As easy and point and shoot.
Digital Range Journal
Save a photo of your target along with automatically calculated shot group metrics like MOA and shot accuracy. Each shot group metric is ranked by percentile giving you instant actionable feedback. Record extra notes and keep all your range info secured and available anywhere you go.
Shooting Insights
Track your progress over time. See how dry firing improves your shot group metrics. View and compare your accuracy using different firearms, munitions, shooting drills, weapon attachments, shooting stances, shooting grips, and much, much more. Over 100+ actionable Insights and counting.
Zero Optics with Infinite Zero
'Infinite Zero' delivers exact MOA adjustments for any zero at any distance. By using the shot group metrics from the 'Ballistics Cam', you can achieve a 36 yard zero with a target 10 yards away or a 300 yard zero with a target 25 yards away. Any zero at any distance, the zero possibilities are infinite.
Dry Fire & Live Fire Goals
Encourage and motivate ongoing training with goals. Maintain a training streak with weekly goals to get your dry fire reps in. Improve accuracy with live fire goals to get your best shot group.
Plus:
Monthly shooting challenges
Training Plans
Drill Insights
Munition Insights
Optic Insights
Global benchmarks
Shot Placement mapping
And much more!

bluejetty:00129527:ios.description:
Replace math anxiety with math positivity.
Math facts are part of our everyday lives. The more confidence you have with the facts, the less stress you will face in daily calculations.
When you're confident with math facts, it opens up every other possibility.
There's no doubt that daily practice improves learning, retention, and mastery.
Leverage learning science for math instruction:
• Studies show you mastered a math fact if you can produce an answer within 3 seconds
• Mixed operations - practicing math skills in a variable order is more effective for long term mastery
• You build mental strategies to answer math problems presented in quick succession
Play the app and see for yourself. The more you practice, the better you will get.
- Practice for 1, 2, or 3 minutes at a time
- Earn achievement medals
- Math-based game curriculum
- Aligned with common core standards
- Try it free!
Great for students practicing their math facts too - help students learn the basic facts, build fluency, and gain confidence. By the end of second grade, students should be fluent with all addition and subtraction facts. By the end of third grade, students should be fluent with facts in all four operations.
Practice these skills:
• Addition and Subtraction
• Multiplication and Division
• Squares, Cubes, and Square Roots
• Fractions and Decimals
• Percentages
Develop new math strategy and build your way up to more difficult challenges.
We love to hear from you! 
Please send any feedback or questions to hello@peekaboo.mobi

bluejetty:00083577:ios.description:
Make your own Minecraft 3D models in minutes, right on your phone. MCPE Model Maker is a 3D model editor for Minecraft Bedrock: start from thousands of free mobs, items, blocks and skins, reshape them, paint new textures and export the files for your next mod.
No PC, no Blockbench install and no modeling experience needed.
BROWSE THOUSANDS OF FREE 3D MODELS
• Mobs, animals, monsters, characters, weapons, items, blocks, furniture and more
• Organized by category and tag, with seasonal packs for Christmas, Halloween, New Year and Mob Vote
• New and trending models added regularly
• Search, bookmark your favorites and find recent work in History
EDIT IN A FULL 3D MODEL EDITOR
• Model mode: add cubes and bones, then move, resize, rotate and set pivots with on-screen gizmos
• Outliner to organize every part of the model
• Preview your model from every angle with smooth 3D rendering
PAINT SKINS AND TEXTURES
• Paint directly on the 3D model or on the flat 2D texture
• Pencil, eraser, bucket fill, brush, gradient, dither, colorize, shapes and eyedropper
• Color palettes and preview poses to check your skin before you export
EXPORT AND IMPORT
• Export your model as geometry JSON, texture/skin PNG and icon
• Import your own skins and textures from your device
• Use the exported files in Minecraft Bedrock / Pocket Edition or your favorite mod tools
WHO IT IS FOR
Mod creators, texture pack artists, skin designers, Blockbench users on the go and every Minecraft fan who wants a custom mob, pet or item of their own.
Need help? Open the FAQ inside the app or email contact@pamobile.co.

You’ve got important work to do for your health.
We’ll help make it easy.
If you’ve recently been diagnosed with high or low blood pressure, it can be a real challenge trying to get your numbers back where they need to be. The Equate™ Heart Health app takes away the struggles of logging blood pressure readings, offering simple, straightforward tracking. It also makes syncing your readings over Bluetooth® to your phone or mobile device smooth and effortless with no need to pair devices.
You’ll appreciate the following Equate Heart Health features:
•Detailed dashboard with filtering allows you to customize your profile so you can monitor your readings through easy-to-decipher charts and information.
•Set reminders to take your blood pressure readings so you can stay accountable and track results.
•Sync to Apple Health, which consolidates health data from your iPhone, Apple Watch, and third-party appproducts so you can view your progress in one convenient place.

Equate 8000 Series - Premium Upper Arm - Blood Pressure Monitor - WMTBPA-240BT
This is a home health care product for data storage only and it is not intended to serve as a substitute for the advice of a physician or medical professional. Users should seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.
Need help? Contact Support at 1-888-287-1915

bluejetty:00026919:ios.summary: Looking to elevate your riding experience and make it more fun and memorable? Consider using REVER - the world's largest GPS app and community for motorcycle, snowmobile, and off-road enthusiasts. With REVER, it's not just about reaching yo
bluejetty:00026919:ios.description:
Looking to elevate your riding experience and make it more fun and memorable? Consider using REVER - the world's largest GPS app and community for motorcycle, snowmobile, and off-road enthusiasts. With REVER, it's not just about reaching your destination; it's about enjoying the epic journey, reliving your route, and sharing it with friends.
Whether you're cruising on your motorcycle, exploring on your ATV, shredding on your snowmobile, or off-roading in your 4x4 vehicle, REVER has got you covered. With our extensive community of riders, we help you plan, navigate, and share your ride from start to finish.
DISCOVER AND PLAN YOUR DREAM ROUTES 
REVER offers an extensive selection of hand-picked routes that cater to various preferences, from smooth and paved to rugged and off-road paths. Discover the best locations to explore and customize your ideal ride with our intuitive in-app route planning. With three different routing engines, you can build your own custom routes with our ADVanced Off-Road Planner, Twisty Routing AI Engine or A to B Guidance. 
TRACK, SHARE, AND COMPETE
Record your rides with REVER, keep them public or mark as private, and track your progress with distance, duration, elevation, and speed (you can also hide your max speed). Join the REVER community to share your adventures, compete in challenges, and connect with like-minded riders from around the globe. Plus, share your route and photos on social media to inspire others to explore.
UNLOCK THE PRO MEMBERSHIP ADVANTAGES
Upgrade to REVER PRO membership and unlock the most robust navigation tools and features, including Butler Maps road recommendations, custom turn-by-turn directions with voice navigation, weather radar and alerts, LiveRIDE Safety Features, 3D Flyover and Explore, and much more. With PRO, you'll get premium map styles, and the ability to download GPX files, offline maps and more!
OFFLINE GPS FOR OFF-THE-GRID ADVENTURES
REVER turns your iPhone® into the best GPS device for your adventures. With built-in GPS, REVER can navigate you through your route, even in airplane mode, and record your rides without any cellular network. Plus, with offline maps and rides, you can explore off-the-grid with confidence.
MANAGE YOUR MEMBERSHIP
Your REVER membership automatically renews, but you can turn off auto-renewal at any time. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Visit our website for full terms of use.
FEEDBACK
We are passionate riders just like you, and we want to hear from you. If you have any problems, suggestions, or want to request new features, please contact us at support@rever.co or through the new Help tab. 
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

CarPlay is a trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries.

bluejetty:00064489:ios.description:
Introducing bKash App, with an elegant look, and exciting features, to make your life simpler and easier. Register a bKash account right from the app in a few minutes, add money from your bank account or card, and get going. Recharge mobile balance, scan QR to pay at your favorite stores, pay utility and other bills from home, send money to people, and get different lifestyle services, all in a highly secure mobile money app. Discover the best bKash offers near you, get suggestions from bKash on what services you can explore next, and use shortcuts for your most frequent transactions in bKash App.
FAST ACCOUNT REGISTRATION
No bKash account? No worry! You can now explore bKash App, its services, features, and offers without an account. After you are done exploring, you can register a new bKash account in a few minutes right from bKash App, using your National ID.
ADD MONEY FROM BANK ACCOUNT & CARD
Now you have an account, but you need money in it, right? Transfer funds instantly from your bank account or card, to any bKash account using the Add Money service.
SUPER FAST QR TRANSACTIONS
Use the Scan QR button in the home screen at stores and shops for Payment, at Agent points for Cash Out or with other bKash users for Send Money – faster and error-free.
OFFERS NEAR YOU
Get the best bKash offers at your nearest payment points, all in one place under the Offers section in your home screen.
TRANSACTION SHORTCUTS
In the My bKash section, use shortcuts for your most frequent transactions to make them faster.
SUGGESTIONS FOR YOU
Find suggestions from bKash on what other services, Merchants, billers, and other partners you can try out.
INBOX – TRANSACTIONS & PROMOTIONS
Access notifications on your latest bKash transactions and promotional offers, from the Inbox button at the bottom of your home screen.
MOBILE RECHARGE
Recharge mobile balance or pay postpaid mobile bills for all major mobile network operators very quickly using amount shortcuts:
• Robi
• Airtel
• Banglalink
• Grameenphone
• Teletalk
Let bKash App take care of latest offers and best deals of your mobile operator. View and purchase recharge-based Internet, Voice and Bundle offers of different mobile operators in Mobile Recharge.
PAY YOUR BILLS
Make payments for your monthly utility bills such as electricity, gas, internet, and other services, right from the comfort of your home.
GET DIFFERENT LIFESTYLE SERVICES
Want a one-stop-shop for your lifestyle needs? Let bKash app be your companion for food delivery, online shopping, bus, train, launch and air tickets, movie tickets, hotel booking for traveling, and many more.
HIGHLY SECURE MOBILE BANKING
We take the security of your bKash account very seriously. We send you an OTP to verify your bKash account during first log-in. bKash App also asks for your PIN during both log-in, and transactions.
EASE OF ACCESS
Use the app in either Bangla or English, and change between the two whenever you want.
STATEMENT
Exert greater control over your mobile wallet by accessing your detailed transaction history, and a monthly transaction summary.
CHECK LIMIT
Know how much more you can transact by having a real-time view of your transaction limits.
ONE-TAP BALANCE CHECK
Checking your balance is just a tap away. We also help protect your data by hiding the balance after a few seconds.
GREATER TRANSPARENCY & CONTROL
Have greater visibility over your bKash transactions – while entering the amount, you will see your available balance, auto-calculated service charge, and projected new balance – all before completing the transaction.

- Write your story in parts (e.g chapters, prologue, etc)

- Ships worldwide

- Export your story as well-structured EPUB file

- EPUB file works on most e-readers, including Apple Books, Kindle, Kobo and many more.
AUDIO BOOKS
- Turn your short stories into high quality audio books
- Listen to audio books for free

- It's like having a best-selling author proofread your writing.

- Keep track of revision history in case you want to revert.

While AI should never be used to fabricate soul, it's terrific for fixing basic grammar issues, reworking an expression, or making other structural changes. This is how AI Revision is designed to work. If you find that it’s over-stepping its boundaries, please let us know. Thank you!
PUBLISH
- Publish your story for other users to read.
- Share story web link with anybody.
- Receive likes and comments.
- Readers can opt-in for post notifications for your story.
- Publish part-by-part updates.
READ & EXPLORE
- Read from tons of original stories & updates published everyday.
- Page curling story reader.
- View author profiles to discover more stories.
- Write encouraging feedback.
- View most liked and latest stories.
STORY WRITER PRO

bluejetty:00029940:ios.description:
ID700 is a hybrid FM/waveshaping software synthesizer based on the voice architecture of the Buchla 700.
ID700 runs in standalone mode and as an AUv3 plugin (Logic Pro, GarageBand, AUM, Cubasis 3).
HISTORY
In 1987 Don Buchla released the Buchla 700 synthesizer. It was the next logical step from Don's previous digital synths (the Buchla 400, Touché, Buchla 500) but was also influenced by the synth trends of the 1980's, specifically FM synthesis and the all-in-one workstation concept. As usual, Don was ahead of the curve and the 700 never took off. Very few were sold and even fewer functioning units exist today. I always loved the sound of Don's digital oscillators, and combined with the scarcity of the instrument it seemed like a fun project to recreate it in software and reintroduce its concepts to the world.
FEATURES
 * AUv3 and Standalone support on iOS
 * twelve voices of four operator FM with twelve unique algorithms
 * fourteen complex envelopes per voice
 * two hundred professionally designed presets
 * two waveshapers per voice
 * preset randomizer
 * over forty factory wave shapes plus an editor for user created shapes
 * Scala scale file support with over four thousand included tunings from the Scala scale archive
 * MPE (MIDI Polyphonic Expression) capability for MPE controllers like the Roli Seabord, Linnstrument, and Sensel Morph
 * advanced MIDI implementation (including 14-bit CCs and Program Change)
 * an in-depth manual (60+ pages) is available in the app and from our website
 * iCloud support for sharing presets, waveshapes, and tunings between devices
 * up to 16x oversampling

bluejetty:00026913:ios.description:
Never forget to take your meds and pills again with the MUST HAVE pill reminder ranked #1 by pharmacists and physicians in independent tests.
Now in the U.S.: See crucial drug-to-drug interaction warnings about how your meds might conflict, as well as easily import your meds and prescriptions using Health Records on iPhone from more than 100 hospitals and health systems in the US. 
Be safe with your meds - Improper medicine use and dosage tracking leads to:
• 50% of patients not taking medicines as prescribed
• 125,000 deaths a year (one every 4 minutes)
• 700,000 hospital visits a year
• 44 out of 100 prescriptions never picked up at the pharmacy
With Medisafe you won't put yourself or your loved ones at risk by missing a dosage -- or taking a double dose because nobody tracked. 
This is the MUST HAVE med app seen on Fox TV, ABC, Mashable, Inc. Magazine, Los Angeles Times, Boston Globe, Life Hacker, Fast Company, TechCrunch, and many more.
Here's why:
CLEAN & SIMPLE: Visual and easy medical manager to handle drug reminders.
HEALTH APP INTEGRATION: Keeps track of your measurements and syncs them to HealthKit app: blood glucose, blood pressure, weight, pulse, temperature and in the US, medications from health records where available.
REPORT SHARING: See your progress report and send it to the doctor or nurse as a visual informative PDF.
FAMILY INTERACTION: Synchronizes the family's medicine pillboxes to one place, in real time. Manage your entire family from one account!
MEDTONES: Various Medtones to make Medisafe playful and a great addition to your day: have Darth Vader, Dr Evil, Austin Powers, Elsa or your Nagging Mom remind you about your meds.
REMINDERS: Reminds you to take medication doses on time every time, even if your device is asleep. Medisafe has timezone support too! No need to worry while traveling, your reminders are always on time.
REFILL REMINDER: Rx refill reminds you when you need to restock your prescriptions.
Pharmacists rank Medisafe #1 out of 461 apps they've tested, and MyVCM recognizes Medisafe for HIPAA privacy "best practices in managing security and compliance."
Medisafe does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding your medications or a medical condition.

bluejetty:00172259:ios.summary:
Transform your puppy into a calm, happy, well-behaved dog, right from home
Raising Dog is your all-in-one dog training and puppy care app. You’ll get a personalized training plan built on positive reinforcement whether you’re a first-time d
bluejetty:00172259:ios.description:
Transform your puppy into a calm, happy, well-behaved dog, right from home
Raising Dog is your all-in-one dog training and puppy care app. You’ll get a personalized training plan built on positive reinforcement whether you’re a first-time dog parent or leveling up obedience. Follow short daily lessons, track progress, and tackle real-life problems like potty accidents, barking, or pulling on the leash. 
1. PLAN TAILORED TO YOUR DOG AND GOALS
Every dog learns differently. Raising Dog adapts to your pup’s age, breed size, and your goals, so training feels doable and fun. You’ll learn core obedience commands like sit, down, stay, recall, and leave it, then build up to reliable real-world manners. 
Raising Dog helps you:
Teach obedience step-by-step with clear demos
Build focus, calmness, and confidence
Use reward-based methods that strengthen your bond 
2. FIX COMMON BEHAVIOR ISSUES
Get guided programs for the challenges most dog owners face:
Potty training / house training
Leash walking without pulling
Excessive barking and jumping
Biting, chewing, and impulse control
You’ll know what to do, when to do it, and how to keep progress steady. 
3. TRICKS & GAMES THAT KEEP TRAINING FUN
Training isn’t just rules, it’s connection. Unlock fun dog tricks and brain games that burn energy to keep the dog calm and reinforce good habits. Great for puppies and adult dogs alike. 
4. TRACKING, REMINDERS, AND ROUTINES
Consistency is everything. Use built-in tools to stay on track:
Potty log and accident tracker
Meal, water, and walk reminders
Training streaks and progress milestones
Notes to spot what works best for your dog
Small daily wins add up fast
Keep a daily track record to share with your vet
Raise a happy and healthy dog
5. TRAIN ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
No classes, no pressure. Train at home, outdoors, or on the go with short sessions that fit real life. The app guides you so you always know the next best step. 
WHY DOG PARENTS LOVE RAISING DOG
Easy puppy training for beginners
Clear obedience lessons and dog tricks
Positive reinforcement approach
Simple potty, meal, and walk tracking
Reminders that keep you consistent
A calmer dog and a stronger bond 
Your personal data is encrypted and protected.
You can delete your account and all associated data at any time directly from within the app.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Raising Dog offers flexible auto-renewing plans.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
You can download and use the app for free. Continued access to all features requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your account settings. Prices may vary by country and currency.
For support or questions, contact us at help@raising.dog
Privacy Policy: https://raising.dog/privacy
Terms of Use: https://raising.dog/terms
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Start your dog training journey today
Download Raising Dog and enjoy step-by-step puppy training, obedience, and behavior support that fits your life and helps your dog thrive.

Do you like anti-stress soft toys such as sequins and slime? If yes, then enjoy the creative process of crafting and painting your own squishy.

- Draw, color, decorate, and pull squishy as you want.
- First of all, Select your favorite model and color it with the help of a color palette.
- Rotate your 3D design while coloring, choose your favorite color from an endless number of options, and don’t forget to paint every part of your toy!
- After coloring, Soft squishy slime ball toys are ready to play. 
- Stretch it, press it and play with it.
- Download the amazing and relaxing slime ball squishy toys simulator game and let the squishy work its antistress magic on your mind.
Features:
- Oddly satisfying super realistic relaxation toys.
- Popular antistress ASMR 3d squishy models.
- Real slimey balls and magical liquid screen.
- Fantastic liquid effects simulator.
- Stretch, pull & smash the DIY slime balls.
- Magical effects, jelly textures, a large selection of color gradient.
- Try to form fidget slimy with your hands.
- Pull, break & smash realistic idle slim lizun.
- Like a real anti-stress slime for heroes.
- Learn how to deal with stress & be happy.
It’s time to relax with your own homemade fluffy DIY squishy toys. Press it, squish it, squeeze it, crush it, and enjoy calming anxiety relief.

bluejetty:00040511:ios.name: The Oldie magazine
bluejetty:00040511:ios.summary: The idea for the Oldie was cooked up 25 years ago by its founding editor, Richard Ingrams, and his much-lamented successor, the late Alexander Chancellor. Their aim was to create a free-thinking, funny magazine, a light-hearted alternative
bluejetty:00040511:ios.description:
The idea for the Oldie was cooked up 25 years ago by its founding editor, Richard Ingrams, and his much-lamented successor, the late Alexander Chancellor. Their aim was to create a free-thinking, funny magazine, a light-hearted alternative to a press obsessed with youth and celebrity. The Oldie is ageless and timeless, free of retirement advice, crammed with rejuvenating wit, intelligence and delight. I look forward to welcoming you to our loyal, ever-growing readership.
Harry Mount, Editor
‘The Oldie? It’s the new Punch, the new New Yorker, it’s brilliant’ Gyles Brandreth
‘The most original magazine in the country’ The Independent
It is a British monthly magazine written "as a light-hearted alternative to a press obsessed with youth and celebrity" and has an mixture of features, arts, book reviews and cartoons.
FEATURES
-The Oldie magazine app is free to download. Purchase single editions or subscribe to The Oldie app at a discounted rate
-Read every issue a whole week before it goes on sale in the shops
-Download the magazine and read it offline, on the move
-Each issue is supplemented by an exclusive Oldie podcast. Further insightful commentary with the brains behind the articles.
-Navigate the app easily using the contents bar and skip to your favourite section. 
-One-click, seamless access to the daily blogs filed to the Oldie website
YOUR APP SUBSCRIPTION
You can purchase an auto-renewable subscription directly from iTunes for £34.99. The subscription will include the current issue and past content (up to August 2015) if you do not already own it as well as every new issue.
A single issue costs £2.99 (save £1.26)
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
- You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period
Privacy Policy: https://theoldie.subscribeonline.co.uk/privacy
Terms of use: https://theoldie.subscribeonline.co.uk/terms-and-conditionsapp

bluejetty:00174489:ios.description:
Looking for an invigorating fitness challenge? Dive into our 28-day Wall Pilates Challenge and experience a new level of strength, flexibility, and balance. Whether you're a seasoned Pilates enthusiast or just starting your fitness journey, our app is designed to elevate your workouts to new heights.
Key Features:
• 28 Day Wall Pilates Workout at Home: Start the year strong with our 28 Days Wall Pilates Challenge—transform your body, one move at a time!
• Chair yoga 30 day challenge: All new 30 day chair yoga challenge & calisthenics exercise.
• Wall Pilates at Your Fingertips: Discover the power of wall-assisted Pilates exercises, carefully curated to target your core, enhance flexibility, and sculpt your body.
• 28-Day Transformation: Embark on a transformative journey with our 28-day challenge. Each day, you'll engage in dynamic Wall Pilates routines that progressively challenge and strengthen your muscles.
• Targeted Workouts: From gentle stretches to intense core workouts, our app offers a variety of exercises suitable for all fitness levels. Whether you're looking to tone your body, improve your posture, or focus on arm workouts, belly fat loss, and lower back pain exercises, we've got you covered.
• Lazy Workout: Stay active even on low-energy days with specialized lazy workout sessions. Embrace a slower pace while keeping your body engaged and maintaining your fitness journey.
• Customizable Workout Plans: Tailor your fitness journey to your preferences with custom plans that allow you to adjust workout and rest times. Handpick exercises that suit your goals and create a regimen that's uniquely yours.
• Personalized Exercise Selection:
Choose from a diverse range of exercises to craft a routine that matches your fitness level and targets specific muscle groups. Your path to success is in your hands.
• Calorie Count and Water Tracking:
Monitor your progress beyond the gym. Easily log your daily calorie intake and track your water consumption to stay on top of your nutritional goals.
• Full Body Workout Patterns:
Experience a well-rounded fitness routine with curated full-body workout patterns. Seamlessly blend cardiovascular exercises, strength training, and flexibility movements for comprehensive results.
Looking for free chair yoga for seniors? Our app includes a full library of gentle chair yoga routines that help improve posture, mobility, and strength — all designed specifically for older adults and beginners. These free workouts are ideal for anyone wanting to stay active without getting down on the floor. Enjoy easy chair yoga, perfect for seniors who want to feel better every day. Whether you're starting your first Pilates challenge or continuing your journey, this is the ideal at-home exercise solution.

• Smart AI fitness coach guidance

I would like to thank you all who encouraged me a lot by your comments and feedback.

iBible-Study HD is offline Bible studying tool based upon the free modules of theWord , a Desktop Bible software.The iBible-Study HD has up to three re-sizable panels to make your study much easier. Each panel has a customizable tabs for Bible , Dictionary , Commentary. Books , Notes , Maps and Search result.
iBible-Study HD comes with King James Version and Treasury of Scripture Knowledge and ,of course, you can download many other resources through the iBible-Study HD Download manager. 
You can download Bibles in more than 100 translations for more than 35 languages (including but not limited to) (English, Arabic, Chinese, Dutch, Finnish, German, Greek, Hebrew, Italian, Spanish ...). Plus downloading the other bible study resources such as Commentaries and Dictionaries.
You can even use your own modules of the theWord bible software as the iBible-Study HD supports the file sharing(The modules must be RTF ).
Main Features:
* Study the Bible anywhere (Offline: Your Bibles and books are in your device).
* Up to three re-sizable panels to make your study much easier.
* Customizable panels: Each panel could have tabs for Bible , Dictionary , Commentary, Books, Notes, Maps and Search result.
* Bible Compare in rows or columns
* Search for words and phrases.
* Popover for cross references ,bible references and Strong's number.
* Pinch to zoom in/out
* One tap to search for the verse's words in the dictionaries.
* Keep track of Bookmarks and History 
* Full screen mode.
* Bible verses highlighting. 
* Bookmark Bible verse, Commentary or dictionary topic.
* Download manager for Bibles , Dictionaries and Commentaries.
* New modules can be installed (.twm or zipped) as direct download or as email attachment.
* Support file sharing. Install new modules through iTunes.
* And It's Free. No ads, no hidden fees.
If you have any questions please visit http://zbestway.com/contact-us 
email me : ibs@zbestway.com

bluejetty:00178949:ios.summary:

Works with any radio firmw
bluejetty:00178949:ios.description:
The Official FlexRadio Systems® Client for iPhone and iPad. Your FLEX-6000, FLEX-8000 or Aurora radio, at home over Wi-Fi or from anywhere with SmartLink™. Made by a ham, for hams, with personal support included.
Works with any radio firmware: SmartSDR v1, v2, v3 and v4, including the newest release.
WORKS WITH
■ FLEX-6300, FLEX-6400, FLEX-6400M, FLEX-6500, FLEX-6600, FLEX-6600M, FLEX-6700
■ FLEX-8400, FLEX-8400M, FLEX-8600, FLEX-8600M
■ AU-510, AU-510M, AU-520, AU-520M (Aurora)
OPERATE
■ Panadapter and waterfall with band plan, DX Cluster, POTA and FT8 spots
■ Slices, filters, TNFs, memories, profiles (TX, microphone, global), transverters, equalizers
■ SmartLink™ remote access, MultiFlex™, SmartControl, APD / SmartSignal™
■ CWX with side tone and live sending, software paddle and straight key
■ Compact floating panels: CWX, Tune Stack, macros, Command Bar, DTMF, RIT / XIT
■ Firmware Update of your radio, right from the app
■ Your iPhone or iPad as microphone and speaker; the radio keeps playing in the background
■ Ready for iPhone Duo, iPad split screen and Apple Vision Pro
MODES
■ FT8-Improved with AutoAnswer and AutoCQ, the classic FT8 and the FT8 Skimmer
■ JS8 keyboard chat
■ CW with decoder, keyer, ESM and CW keyboard
■ Speech: incoming voice transcribed and translated, your typed text sent as speech
■ SSTV, HF-Fax, APRS and WSPR
FT8-Improved, JS8, Speech and WSPR need iOS 26.
TOOLS
■ Logbook with ADIF import and export, shared via iCloud with SDR-Control, FT-Control, TS-Control and K4-Control, on iPhone, iPad and Mac
■ DX Cluster, POTA, PSK Reporter, Call Lookup, Band Plan, Network Stats
■ 4O3A Genius devices (Power, Tuner, Antenna and Rotator Genius), Ultra Beam antennas
■ HomeKit: switch your radio, antenna switches and other devices
■ Controllers: MIDI, CTR2, HaliKey, Pryme, Flic, PowerMate
MADE BY A HAM
Made by Marcus, DL8MRE, who has been developing apps for Apple devices since 2009 and uses this app every day in his own shack. Personal online support and a detailed manual are included. Updates with new modes and features are free: no subscription, no in-app purchases.
WHAT YOU NEED
■ One of the radios above, on your network
■ An iPhone or iPad with iOS 18 or later
■ For SmartLink™: a radio set up for SmartLink (SmartSDR v2 or later)
Manual: https://go-to.me/smartsdr-manual
More apps: https://ham-radio-apps.com

bluejetty:00090942:ios.description:
SnapOut – Quit Lust. Reclaim Control. Live Fully.
SnapOut is the ultimate self-improvement and habit-breaking app for anyone ready to quit lust, overcome compulsive behaviors, and regain focus, energy, and confidence. Whether you’re starting a purity journey, strengthening your discipline, or building a Christ-centered life, SnapOut is your daily system for real transformation.
Built on neuroscience, behavioral psychology, and faith-based principles, SnapOut helps you renew your mind, take control of your impulses, and become the person God created you to be.
Why SnapOut Works
RENEW YOUR MIND
SnapOut uses research-based techniques and biblical wisdom to help you break free from destructive patterns and reset your brain’s reward system. It’s more than a streak counter — it’s a full identity shift.
DAILY WINS THAT COMPOUND
Turn moments of temptation into growth through guided exercises, journaling, Scripture-based reflections, and micro-challenges. Every decision strengthens your discipline and your walk with God.
VISUALIZE YOUR PROGRESS
Track your streak, monitor your mental and spiritual growth, and see your transformation through clean, powerful dashboards.
BUILD YOUR BREAKTHROUGH TREE
Your personal tree grows every time you choose self-control and purpose. You’re not just avoiding something — you’re becoming someone new.
REMOVE TRIGGERS AND STAY FOCUSED
SnapOut includes AI-powered tools, content blockers, and focus systems designed to help you avoid temptation and stay aligned with your goals and values.
A CHRISTIAN COMMUNITY THAT STANDS WITH YOU
You are not alone. Connect with others pursuing purity, discipline, and a deeper relationship with Christ. Share wins, grow through challenges, and stay encouraged.
REAL TOOLS FOR REAL LIFE
From guided meditations and expert coaching to smart notifications and customizable protection systems, SnapOut supports you in the moments that matter most.
UNLOCK YOUR GOD-GIVEN POTENTIAL
Freedom from lust is not the finish line — it’s the foundation. SnapOut helps you rebuild confidence, strengthen your identity, and live with clarity, purpose, and spiritual strength.
What Users Are Saying
“SnapOut gave me the structure and spiritual focus I needed to finally walk in freedom.”
“This app helped me stop falling into the same cycle and start rebuilding my life with God at the center.”
“It’s not just about quitting — it’s about becoming the man I’m called to be.”
Subscription Information
Upgrade to SnapOut Premium to unlock the full transformation system, including:
• Advanced recovery and discipline tools
• AI-powered blockers and focus modes
• Private faith-based community access
• Exclusive dopamine reset modules
• Christian guided content and reflections
Your subscription will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription anytime in your App Store settings.
Disclaimer: SnapOut is a behavioral support and lifestyle improvement app designed to support personal and spiritual growth. It does not replace professional medical or psychological treatment. If you are struggling with severe compulsive behaviors, please consult a licensed health provider.
Privacy Policy: http://snapout.co/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://snapout.co/terms.html
Contact: info.snapout@gmail.com

bluejetty:00027158:ios.summary:
Valhalla awaits, Viking!
Build, survive, fight and conquer - become a Viking worthy of Valhalla!
Arrange your own base, harness the power of gods and fight the army of the dead with your friends. Bring back the former glory to the Viking l
bluejetty:00027158:ios.description:
Valhalla awaits, Viking!
Build, survive, fight and conquer - become a Viking worthy of Valhalla!
Arrange your own base, harness the power of gods and fight the army of the dead with your friends. Bring back the former glory to the Viking lands by building a new capital from scratch, and go to uncharted shores for treasures and new battles and build your own Viking Kingdom. All of this and more awaits you in the new online survival RPG Frostborn!
The world plunged into darkness
In the wilds of Midgard, the dead roam in broad daylight.The water from the rivers burns your throat, Valkyries no longer take the fallen in battle to Valhalla and something sinister is hiding among the shadows of forests and gorges. The goddess Hel is responsible for all this. She cursed these lands with her black magic in just 15 days, and now she wants to enslave the kingdom of the living! 
Death no longer exists
You are the immortal, valiant Jarl of the northern warriors who no longer face death. Healers and shamans shrug their shoulders and don’t understand why this is happening. But since the way to Valhalla is closed, there is only one thing left to do - arm yourself and send the creatures of darkness back to Helheim!
No man is an island
Frostborn is a co-op survival game with MMORPG elements: team up with other Vikings to build a strong base, confront the creatures that hide among the shadows and in the shrines of the gods and fight other players during raids and random encounters in numerous locations and dungeons.
Berserk, mage or assassin - the choice is yours
Choose from over a dozen RPG-style classes that suit you best. Do you like heavy armor and face-to-face battles? Choose between Protector, Berserk or Thrasher! Prefer to keep your distance and shoot arrows at enemies from afar? Pathfinder, Sharpshooter or Hunter at your service! Or are you one of those who hide among the shadows and stab in the back? Try a Bandit, Robber or Assassin! And there is more!
Win at all costs
Trade with other players or ambush and assassinate them in the wilds of Midgard. Make peace with another family and protect each other during the raid, or betray their trust and reveal their secrets to others in exchange for resources. The old order no longer exists, now these are wild lands where the strongest survive.
Plow your way to Valhalla
Use the crafting system inherent in real MMORPGs to get everything you need to defeat the darkness created by the black magic of the goddess Hel. Strong walls and delicious food, magic potions and deadly traps, powerful weapons and legendary armor. And if that's not enough - build your own drakkar to raid the overseas kingdoms!
Build your own city
Strong walls, spacious houses and artisan shops - and this is not all that needs to be rebuilt and improved to open the gates of your city to visitors. But be ready for a long journey - a good city cannot be built in 15 days. Coop with other Vikings and the inhabitants of your city to fight for a place in the sun in a world ruled by black magic.
There's no daylight underground
Go down to the ancient sanctuaries of the gods - dungeons in the best traditions of MMORPGs, fight the strongest dead and monsters who are afraid of daylight, get legendary artifacts and find out why the gods left this world.
Experience the survival RPG Frostborn - a new game from the Kefir studio, the creators of Last Day on Earth and Grim Soul. Join now and in 15 days you will understand what it is like to live like a Viking!

bluejetty:00023037:ios.summary:
Take command of your wireless service, anywhere at any time! The new and improved Net 10 My Account App lets you manage your wireless service right from your phone. In fact, all you need is a Net 10 account and your phone. 
If you are a Ne
bluejetty:00023037:ios.description:
Take command of your wireless service, anywhere at any time! The new and improved Net 10 My Account App lets you manage your wireless service right from your phone. In fact, all you need is a Net 10 account and your phone. 
If you are a Net 10 customer, you can use this App to manage all aspects of your wireless service.
Here is how it works:
Download and open the app, then proceed to the End User License Agreement.
- If you agree to the End User License Agreement, you will have the option to log in if you already have a Net 10 Account, or use the app to create one!
- Upon logging in, you will be able to track your Data Usage on your Home Screen, redeem Net 10 Airtime PINs, and purchase Net 10 airtime with a Credit Card. 
You can also update your Net 10 Profile, among many others features!
Airtime PINs are located on the back of the Net10 Service Card or on your register receipt. To read the PIN on a Net 10 Service Card, locate the grey strip on the back of the card. Scratch off the gray strip to reveal the PIN.
Service Cards are sold at over 80,000 retail locations across the United States; visit https://www.net10.com/direct/retailers for more information. 
Not a Net 10 customer? Switch now! Visit us at http://www.net10wireless.com for more information.
Net10 from TracFone, a Verizon Company.

bluejetty:00042061:ios.name: Fi - GPS Dog Tracker
bluejetty:00042061:ios.summary:
Fi Series 3+ is the world's smartest GPS dog collar—now powered by AI.
Paired with a Fi collar, the Fi app brings you even closer to your dog. Track their location, monitor activity and health patterns, and get alerts if they ever leave a
bluejetty:00042061:ios.description:
Fi Series 3+ is the world's smartest GPS dog collar—now powered by AI.
Paired with a Fi collar, the Fi app brings you even closer to your dog. Track their location, monitor activity and health patterns, and get alerts if they ever leave a safe zone. It's peace of mind for the best pet parents out there.
FEATURES
GPS TRACKING 
On vacation? Friend walking the dog? Instantly track your dog's location no matter where they are. Fi gives you the confidence to know they're safe from anywhere, anytime.
STOP ESCAPE ARTISTS
Designate safe zones around your home or dog's favorite places. If they leave without a trusted person, we'll alert you immediately. So if they wander anywhere, you'll be the first to know.
ACTIVITY MONITORING
Track your dog's step count daily and start streaks by achieving custom goals you set. Then see how they compare with similar dogs in the Fi community. Every step goes a long way toward keeping them happy and healthy.
AI BEHAVIOR INSIGHTS
Fi Series 3+ tracks more than just steps. Spot trends in activity, rest, scratching, licking, drinking, eating, and barking so you can stay in tune with your dog's health and habits, every day.
LOST DOG MODE
Never lose track again. If your dog goes missing, activate Lost Dog Mode to turn on rapidly refreshing live location updates until they're found.
BATTERY LIFE
With best-in-class battery, our collars lasts up to 3 months on a single charge. No other collar even comes close.
SUPPORT
Need help? We're here for you and your dog. Our support team is just a chat or phone call away when you need.
APPLE WATCH INTEGRATION
With our all new Series 3+, you can view your dog's location and activity directly on your wrist, so you're always connected, even without your phone.
OUR COLLAR
Available in 4 different colors and 5 different sizes to fit dogs of all sizes.
Fi works best when connected near a Bluetooth connected device with the Fi App or the provided charging base. The latest iOS version is required to run Fi. Learn more about what we're building at: www.tryfi.com.

Johnno & Pete

bluejetty:00023151:ios.description:
Mit der offiziellen Ö3-App kannst du am iPhone oder am iPad Ö3 live hören und alle Sendungen der letzten 7 Tage nachhören.
- Ö3-Player: Auf dem Display siehst du den Moderator oder die Moderatorin der laufenden Sendung und das Cover des gerade gespielten Hits. 
- 7-Tages-Player: Bequem navigierst du im Programm der letzten 7 Tage und kannst alle Sendungen und Beiträge nachhören. (Aus lizenzrechtlichen Gründen können alle Musiktitel nachgehört, aber nicht direkt angesteuert werden.) Egal, was du anhörst, der Beitrag läuft weiter, während du in der App schmökerst. Mit dem „Live“-Button kannst du jederzeit bequem zum Liveprogramm zurückkehren. Mit der der Taste „20 Sekunden“ kannst du im Programm nach vor- und zurückspringen.
- Suche: Dank der Suchfunktion kannst du gezielt nach Beiträgen (etwa: Allein gegen Kratky, Ö3-Mikromann) suchen und alle Folgen der letzten 7 Tage auf einmal nachhören.
- Unter Highlights findest du die besten Beiträge der letzten 7 Tage (Livegäste, Comedy, etc.), die wir für dich ausgesucht haben. Dort findest du auch die jüngste Nachrichtensendung, den aktuellen Wetterbericht und den letzten Verkehrseinstieg.
- Ö3-Live-Cam: Du kannst jederzeit einen Blick in das Ö3-Sendestudio werfen, auch im „Landscape-Modus“.
- Podcasts: Du findest alle Podcasts von Ö3, kannst sie in der App sofort anhören oder in einen anderen Pod-Catcher laden (Apple-Podcast, Spotify).
- Mitbestimmen: Teile uns mit, ob du den angezeigten Hit öfter oder seltener hören willst. Deine Wertung beeinflusst die wöchentlichen Ö3-Hörercharts.
- Favoriten: Beiträge und Lieblingshits kannst du in deiner persönlichen Favoritenliste abspeichern.
- Unter Stories findest Du die aktuellen Beiträge der Ö3-Homepage (oe3.ORF.at).
- Ö3-Verkehrsservice: Alle aktuellen Verkehrsmeldungen findest Du außerdem in einer Straßenkarte und in einer Liste.
- Sende eine persönliche Nachricht an Ö3 und schicke ein Foto, Video oder ein Audiofile direkt ins Ö3-Studio.
- Push-Nachrichten: Aktiviere gratis zahlreiche Push-Nachrichten, den Ö3-Newsflash aus der Nachrichtenredaktion, den Ö3-Sportnewsflash, täglich das Horoskop für dein Sternzeichen von Gerda Rogers, das Wetter für dein Bundesland oder auf Wunsch Infos zu aktuellen Ö3-Aktionen und Gewinnspielen. Abonnierst du die Push-Nachricht Ö3-Highlights, schicken wir dir eine Nachricht, damit du ausgesuchte Programmhighlights live hören kannst (prominente Livegäste, unvergessliche Programmmomente).
- Radiowecker & Sleeping-Funktion: Lass dich mit Ö3 wecken. Nütze den Sleep-Timer, um mit Ö3 einzuschlafen.
- Multi-Task: Du kannst Ö3 auch weiter hören, wenn du zu einer anderen Anwendung wechselst („Multi-Task“). 
- Am Tablet unterstützt die App den „Landscape-Modus“, kann also alternativ im Hoch- und Querformat genutzt werden. 
- Die Ö3-App ist für „AirPlay“ und die „Apple-Watch“ gerüstet.

listings.name: Hitradio Ö3
listings.description:
Mit der offiziellen Ö3-App kannst du am iPhone oder am iPad Ö3 live hören und alle Sendungen der letzten 7 Tage nachhören.

- Ö3-Player: Auf dem Display siehst du den Moderator oder die Moderatorin der laufenden Sendung und das Cover des gerade gespielten Hits. 
- 7-Tages-Player: Bequem navigierst du im Programm der letzten 7 Tage und kannst alle Sendungen und Beiträge nachhören. (Aus lizenzrechtlichen Gründen können alle Musiktitel nachgehört, aber nicht direkt angesteuert werden.) Egal, was du anhörst, der Beitrag läuft weiter, während du in der App schmökerst. Mit dem „Live“-Button kannst du jederzeit bequem zum Liveprogramm zurückkehren.  Mit der der Taste „20 Sekunden“ kannst du im Programm nach vor- und zurückspringen.
- Suche: Dank der Suchfunktion kannst du gezielt nach Beiträgen (etwa: Allein gegen Kratky, Ö3-Mikromann) suchen und alle Folgen der letzten 7 Tage auf einmal nachhören.
- Unter Highlights findest du die besten Beiträge der letzten 7 Tage (Livegäste, Comedy, etc.), die wir für dich ausgesucht haben. Dort findest du auch die jüngste Nachrichtensendung, den aktuellen Wetterbericht und den letzten Verkehrseinstieg.
- Ö3-Live-Cam: Du kannst jederzeit einen Blick in das Ö3-Sendestudio werfen, auch im „Landscape-Modus“.
- Podcasts: Du findest alle Podcasts von Ö3, kannst sie in der App sofort anhören oder in einen anderen Pod-Catcher laden (Apple-Podcast, Spotify).
- Mitbestimmen: Teile uns mit, ob du den angezeigten Hit öfter oder seltener hören willst. Deine Wertung beeinflusst die wöchentlichen Ö3-Hörercharts.
- Favoriten: Beiträge und Lieblingshits kannst du in deiner persönlichen Favoritenliste abspeichern.
- Unter Stories findest Du die aktuellen Beiträge der Ö3-Homepage (oe3.ORF.at).
- Ö3-Verkehrsservice: Alle aktuellen Verkehrsmeldungen findest Du außerdem in einer Straßenkarte und in einer Liste.
- Sende eine persönliche Nachricht an Ö3 und schicke ein Foto, Video oder ein Audiofile direkt ins Ö3-Studio.
- Push-Nachrichten: Aktiviere gratis zahlreiche Push-Nachrichten, den Ö3-Newsflash aus der Nachrichtenredaktion, den Ö3-Sportnewsflash, täglich das Horoskop für dein Sternzeichen von Gerda Rogers, das Wetter für dein Bundesland oder auf Wunsch Infos zu aktuellen Ö3-Aktionen und Gewinnspielen. Abonnierst du die Push-Nachricht Ö3-Highlights, schicken wir dir eine Nachricht, damit du ausgesuchte Programmhighlights live hören kannst (prominente Livegäste, unvergessliche Programmmomente).
- Radiowecker & Sleeping-Funktion: Lass dich mit Ö3 wecken. Nütze den Sleep-Timer, um mit Ö3 einzuschlafen.
- Multi-Task:  Du kannst Ö3 auch weiter hören, wenn du zu einer anderen Anwendung wechselst („Multi-Task“). 
- Am Tablet unterstützt die App den „Landscape-Modus“, kann also alternativ im Hoch- und Querformat genutzt werden. 
- Die Ö3-App ist für „AirPlay“ und die „Apple-Watch“ gerüstet.
- Siri-Shortcuts: Mit dem Befehl „Spiele Ö3“ wird die App automatisch gestartet.

bluejetty:00126914:ios.description:
Gifted test prep app improves your child's cognitive thinking skills. It has thousands of questions for CogAT, NNAT, OLSAT & CCAT that your child will enjoy solving & will strengthen his/her CogAT nonverbal, verbal, and quantitative skills. It will also help you identify your child's weaknesses & help them improve. The questions in this gifted & talented: test prep app are based on the latest pattern Cognitive Abilities Test, Naglieri Nonverbal Ability Test, Otis-Lennon School Ability Test and Canadian Cognitive Abilities Test .
Irrespective of whether you intend to have your child take the CCAT, NNAT, OLSAT & CogAT assessment, questions in the Gifted talented test prep app will help him/her improve their abstract reasoning skills 
Separate batteries in these cognitive exams appraise general cognitive skills using verbal, quantitative, and non verbal test tasks
> Quantitative (Number Analogies, Number Puzzles, Number Series)
> Verbal (Picture Analogies, Sentence Completion, Picture Classification)
> Non-Verbal (Figure Matrices, Paper Folding, Figure Classification)
Gifted will help testing mom & dad for CogAT, OLSAT, CCAT & NNAT prep of their child and assist their child to master the skills needed to ace the cognitive abilities test. This CCAT, OLSAT, NNAT & CogAT test online app provides you with more than 42,000+ practice questions for kindergarten, grade 1, grade 2, grade 3, grade 4, grade 5, grade 6, grade 7 and grade 8 along with free practice tests. 
Assess your child's cognitive strengths & weaknesses, identify areas of improvement, and help them to prepare more effectively for CogAT, NNAT, OLSAT & CCAT. The free version of this CogAT test quest prep app comes with 300+ free questions for kindergarten to grade 8. 
With Gifted test prep app, you can help your little learner to understand materials in preschool or elementary school better. Practice CogAT, NNAT, OLSAT & Canadian CCAT worksheets for Kindergarten, Grade 1 & 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and eliminate his/her weaknesses. 
More than 42,000 CogAT, CCAT, OLSAT & NNAT Practice Questions ~ This cognitive abilities test practice app provides a wide variety of questions from all the 9 question types for gifted and talented education program preparation
Personalized Learning Experience ~ Works on general and specific cognitive abilities. Develops logical and reasoning skills for NNAT, OLSAT, CCAT & CogAT prep
Unlimited Practice Tests ~ You can customize preparation by creating tests from all 9 test categories and help your gifted and talented child for Cognitive abilities test quest for kindergarten to 8th grade
Daily Tests ~ Master the latest CCAT, NNAT, OLSAT & CogAT grade 8to kindergarten test pattern & get used to the format of the cognitive ability assessment test 
Detailed Explanations ~ enables users to compare and understand the answers of their CogAT practice tests. Question DNA measures the reasoning and problem-solving skills for online practice tests
Regular revision of mistakes in practice tests ~ With daily revision, your child can specifically work on improving his weaknesses for CogAT, NNAT, CCAT & OLSAT prep and feels confident on test day 
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING TERMS 
Gifted offers a yearly subscription option for Premium membership. 
Gifted Premium yearly: $74.99 
This price is for customers in US & pricing varies by location. Your subscription will automatically renew within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the price of the subscription and your payment card will be charged through your iTunes account. Refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of the term. You can cancel your subscription, or turn off automatic renewal, in the Account Settings section of your App Store or iTunes settings after you have made the purchase
You can review our privacy policy
https://gifted.achieve.ai/policy/privacy & our terms of use https://gifted.achieve.ai/policy/terms

bluejetty:00115661:ios.description:
Bloom Garden - A Flower Sort Adventure awaits you
Welcome to Bloom Garden, the ultimate flower game where nature meets logic! Immerse yourself in a vibrant world filled with color, charm, and the peaceful beauty of flowers. In this relaxing and satisfying flower game, your goal is to sort and organize stunning blossoms into matching groups to make them bloom in harmony.
In this flower game, each level presents you with vases filled with a mix of colorful flowers - roses, tulips, sunflowers, daisies, and many more. Your task is simple: rearrange the flowers by color and type until every vase holds only one kind of blossom. It’s a satisfying challenge that combines visual delight with thoughtful strategy. As you progress through levels, the puzzles grow more complex, testing your memory, logic, and sorting skills.
Whether you’re a casual player or a devoted fan of flower sort games, Bloom Garden offers something for everyone. With calming visuals, gentle music, and intuitive controls, it's the perfect flower game to relax and unwind. Watching your carefully sorted flowers bloom into beautiful arrangements is not only rewarding—it’s mesmerizing.
Each stage of this flower game is like walking through a magical garden, filled with new flower varieties and beautiful designs. Customize your town as you unlock new pots, garden themes, and blossoming surprises. The more you play, the more your town comes to life - one bloom at a time.
Perfect for fans of flower games, Bloom Garden blends soothing gameplay with the charm of nature. There are no timers or pressure - just pure floral fun. Whether you're on a short break or spending a cozy evening in, this is your go-to flower game for moments of peace and joy.
Download the Bloom Garden game now and step into a world where every blossom counts. Get ready to sort, bloom, and build your very own floral paradise!

Dynamic Golfers is the ultimate program designed specifically for golfers who want to enhance their performance, prevent injuries, and enjoy pain-free golf for years to come. With our comprehensive video programs, you'll have everything you need to take your training to the next level.
■ BENEFITS OF DYNAMIC GOLFERS
+ Gain flexibility, strength, and balance with each routine
+ Reduce joint stiffness and improve your range of motion
+ Boost speed and endurance
+ Accelerate recovery and feel stronger than ever before
+ Improve posture and reduce the risk of injuries
+1000s of routines to choose from with new content added all the time
■ DYNAMIC GOLFERS PROGRAMS
Daily Stretching & Mobility - 15-20 minute daily routines that progress with you. 
Strength Training - Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced programs that use minimal equipment so you can do them at home. 
Injury Prevention - Hip Function & Rehab Program (6 weeks), Knee Function & Rehab (6 Weeks), Posture Corrections, Wrist & Shoulder
Warmups & Drills - Routines to get you ready on the course.
Roll & Release - Guided rolling and releasing techniques to alleviate muscle tightness and speed up recovery. 
■ EASY TO GET STARTED 
New to mobility or strength training? Get started with our 7 Day On Ramp that will walk you through the programs and how to make the most of both your time and membership. 
■ AVAILABLE ACROSS YOUR DEVICES 
Your Dynamic Golfers account enables access to all programming and allows you to stream videos on your iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, pliability’s website or to any AirPlay-compatible device. The videos are also downloadable to make offline viewing easier.

bluejetty:00171197:ios.description:
Christmas Tile Connect is an onet type-matching puzzle game for all ages! You have to find the matching pairs of images in the game field. Train your brain with our game!
Christmas Tile Connect is a matching game with simple rules but complex strategies. Players search for matches among different types of images. Build various paths to connect several tiles. Your goal is to connect all the pairs and leave the board empty!
HOW TO PLAY
- Find two identical tiles without the block of other tiles! Look carefully at what pictures they are.
- Tap the tiles to connect with a maximum of three straight lines! More than three will not be accepted.
- Use powerful tools as you want! If you encounter difficulties, don't give up, try the assistance.
- Crush all the tiles within a limited time! Keep an eye on the timer when connecting.
- Pass levels one by one to become a tile master! Play with your friends together to see who is the best.

bluejetty:00121557:ios.name: Lemmings: Strategy & Puzzle
bluejetty:00121557:ios.summary:
Lemmings game is an offline classic puzzle game in which you have to guide Lemmings in the right direction for their survival, build with tools and use commands to get them out of traps and puzzles to win missions.
Lemmings is a classic p
bluejetty:00121557:ios.description:
Lemmings game is an offline classic puzzle game in which you have to guide Lemmings in the right direction for their survival, build with tools and use commands to get them out of traps and puzzles to win missions.
Lemmings is a classic puzzle strategy game for those who love to play survival games. There are thousands of levels available to enjoy the endless Lemmings fun. Lemmings are crazy, they run through the Lasers independently- You have to save the Lemmings by directing them in the right direction. You have to keep the Lemmings safe and away from traps and obstacles to solve puzzles. You actually have to help the cute Lemmings in their death survival mission. 
You can unlock various rewards, including new ways to overcome traps, new boosters and new Lemmings to add into your collections by progressing in this Lemmings puzzle game. We are frequently releasing new seasons and planets that contain levels, puzzle challenges and new uniquely designed Lemmings to use. Just download Lemmings puzzle offline, plan a survival strategy to survive the traps, to overcome hurdles and to get Lemmings out of danger. Your mission in this game is to keep Lemmings safe from the traps and hurdles by using different puzzle strategies in the game. It is very simple and easy to use survival tools in Lemmings.
How to play Lemmings puzzle game?
Each level in this classic puzzle game has a set number of Lemmings that spawn which you must direct to the objective - an exit point. In order to get the Lemmings to that point safely you have to pass different traps, obstacles and puzzles. Lemmings aren’t very smart and will keep running through lasers, they will keep continuously running unless you guide and direct them by using your strategy to complete the Lemmings game missions. You need to be fast to set up your commands to turn them to an exit point and to save the Lemmings.
Initially it would be difficult for you to play the challenging missions in this Lemmings offline puzzle game, but by playing 1 to 2 missions it would become easy for you to help the Lemmings in getting them out of the dangerous zone.
Below are a few of the tools and commands that you can use in Lemmings survival::
Dig: Dig through destructible blocks to pass cute Lemmings through them
Umbrella: Slow down Lemmings fallings by using it and survive Lemmings from death
Blocker: Block Lemmings and make them turn away from the dangers, obstacles and traps
Staircase: Build a diagonal staircase to get your Lemmings to higher places before their trapping and destruction
Destroy: Sacrifice a Lemming to blow up and to destroy any built structure to move towards an exit point
Rocket: Destroy blocks above your Lemmings for survival
XP System:
While you are playing through levels, you will earn Lemmings puzzle experience that adds up. Once you earn enough XP you will level up and be rewarded with various Lemmings boosters, tools for survival and special Lemmings for free.
Seasons & Planets:
Every two weeks we update the game with either a new season or a new planet in this Lemmings puzzle strategy game. Each season comes along with 32 new Lemmings for you to unlock along with some challenging missions. Each planet releases with new challenging levels. This means that you would always have more than enough challenges to accept and win in this Lemmings offline game.

https://exient.com/games-privacy-policy/
